description: Residual variability in a learner's response that cannot be reduced by any better model of the learner, treated as an intrinsic ceiling on how precisely the construct can be measured.
description-chinese: 学习者反应中无法通过更优模型消除的残余波动，构念测量的精度上限。

name: logical judgment
label: education
description: Reasoned evaluative judgment that proceeds by weighing evidence and logical entailment rather than by uncritical acceptance, occupying the rational pole as opposed to empirical or traditional judgment. Its epistemic force depends on whether the premises invoked are themselves warranted, a dependence that recurs at every level of justificatory practice.
description-chinese: 依据证据与逻辑蕴涵进行权衡的评价性判断，与经验判断或传统判断相对而构成理性一极。

name: low-level question
label: education
description: A classroom question whose answer is directly available in the lesson material or requires only recall and simple comprehension, engaging the lower rungs of Bloom's taxonomy. It is cheap to answer, demands little reasoning and rarely yields evidence about how the learner has organised the material in memory.
description-chinese: 答案可直接从课文中获取或仅需回忆与简单理解的低阶课堂提问。

name: mastery
label: education
cite-abstract: Most students, perhaps over 90 percent, can master what teachers have to teach them, and it is the task of instruction to find the means which will enable students to master the subject under consideration. A basic task is to determine what is meant by mastery of the subject and to search for methods and materials which will enable the largest proportion of students to attain such mastery. That is, the basic task in education is to find strategies which will take individual differences into consideration but in such a way as to promote the fullest development of the individual. The thesis of this paper is that, to promote mastery learning, 5 variables must be dealt with effectively: (1) aptitude for kinds of learning, viewed as the amount of time required by the learner to attain mastery of the task; (2) quality of instruction, viewed in terms of its approaching the optimum for a given learner; (3) ability to understand instruction, i.e., to understand the nature of the task and the procedures to follow; (4) perseverance, the amount of time one is willing to spend in learning; and (5) time allowed for learning, the key to mastery.
description: The state in which a concept or procedure has been internalised well enough to be recalled and applied fluently without external support, treated by mastery learning theory as the precondition for advancing.
description-chinese: 概念或程序已内化到无需外部支持即可流畅提取与应用的状态。

name: mastery-based grading
label: education
cite-abstract: Most students, perhaps over 90 percent, can master what teachers have to teach them, and it is the task of instruction to find the means which will enable students to master the subject under consideration. A basic task is to determine what is meant by mastery of the subject and to search for methods and materials which will enable the largest proportion of students to attain such mastery. That is, the basic task in education is to find strategies which will take individual differences into consideration but in such a way as to promote the fullest development of the individual. The thesis of this paper is that, to promote mastery learning, 5 variables must be dealt with effectively: (1) aptitude for kinds of learning, viewed as the amount of time required by the learner to attain mastery of the task; (2) quality of instruction, viewed in terms of its approaching the optimum for a given learner; (3) ability to understand instruction, i.e., to understand the nature of the task and the procedures to follow; (4) perseverance, the amount of time one is willing to spend in learning; and (5) time allowed for learning, the key to mastery.
description: Grading that reports the level of knowledge demonstrated against a mastery threshold, distinguishing partial from complete competence instead of merely ranking performance. It aligns grading with the logic of mastery learning, in which evidence is collected repeatedly until a defined threshold of competence has been demonstrated.
description-chinese: 以掌握阈值为基准报告所展示的知识水平、区分部分胜任与完全胜任的计分方式。

name: memory recall
label: education
cite-abstract: Taking a memory test not only assesses what one knows, but also enhances later retention, a phenomenon known as the testing effect. We studied this effect with educationally relevant materials and investigated whether testing facilitates learning only because tests offer an opportunity to restudy material. In two experiments, students studied prose passages and took one or three immediate free-recall tests, without feedback, or restudied the material the same number of times as the students who received tests. Students then took a final retention test 5 min, 2 days, or 1 week later. When the final test was given after 5 min, repeated studying improved recall relative to repeated testing. However, on the delayed tests, prior testing produced substantially greater retention than studying, even though repeated studying increased students' confidence in their ability to remember the material. Testing is a powerful means of improving learning, not just assessing it.
description: The capacity to retrieve previously encoded information from long-term store without the cue present at encoding, typically probed by delayed free recall and contrasted with recognition, and known to improve through spacing, retrieval practice and interleaving.
description-chinese: 在无提示条件下从长期记忆存储中提取已编码信息的能力，通常以延迟自由回忆测量，可经间隔与提取练习改善。

name: mental activity
label: education
description: The umbrella category covering cognitive, emotional and volitional processes occurring within the individual, including sensation, perception, memory, thinking, feeling and will as interacting rather than separate functions. The category is hierarchical rather than flat, since volitional and emotional processes typically presuppose cognitive operations of some minimal kind.
description-chinese: 涵盖个体内部认知、情感与意志过程的上位类别，包括感觉、知觉、记忆、思维、情感与意志。

name: middle-school entrance exam
label: education
description: The high-stakes selection examination at the transition from primary to secondary schooling, used for placement decisions and increasingly reshaped toward comprehensive cross-subject competency assessment. Reforms toward comprehensive assessment attempt to reduce the narrowing effects that high-stakes single-point admission examinations historically produce.
description-chinese: 小学升入初中的高利害选拔考试，用于升学分流，并日益向综合性跨学科评价方向改革。

name: mobile terminal
label: education
description: Portable computing devices such as tablets and smartphones through which learners and teachers access instructional content, submit work, communicate and reflect beyond the physical classroom boundary. Always-present devices also introduce attentional competition, making deliberate task separation a necessary design consideration rather than an optional extra.
description-chinese: 平板、手机等便携计算设备，学习者与教师借此在课堂之外获取教学资源、提交作业并进行沟通。

name: multimodal content analysis
label: education
description: Joint analysis of video, audio and physiological or annotation streams from an interaction, in which each modality is transcribed to a common timeline so that verbal, vocal and non-verbal behaviour can be related rather than reported in isolation.
description-chinese: 对互动的视频、语音与生理或标注流进行联合分析，统一到同一时间轴以关联言语、声音与非言语行为。

name: multimodal data collection
label: education
description: Simultaneous acquisition of synchronised video, microphone, eye-tracking and physiological streams with shared timestamps and informed consent, requiring calibrated sensor synchronisation and a data schema that permits reliable multimodal alignment downstream for both measurement and replay.
description-chinese: 以共享时间戳同步采集视频、麦克风、眼动与生理信号流，需校准传感器同步并建立可对齐的数据模式。

name: narrative
label: education
description: A structured account of causally connected events unfolding over time, used in research as a stimulus or data format: children asked to retell a narrative show how comprehension is reconstructed rather than copied, revealing inferences and causal links not stated in the text.
description-chinese: 由因果相连事件随时间展开的结构化叙述，作为刺激或数据形式用于考察读者的理解重建与推断。

name: neurotypical
label: education
description: Describing a person whose social communication, sensory processing and behavioural repertoire fall within the typical developmental range, used as the reference category in developmental research and in studies contrasting autistic and non-autistic participants.
description-chinese: 指社会沟通、感觉处理与行为表现处于典型发展范围的个体，常作为发展研究的参照类别。

name: object-oriented activity
label: education
description: Activity through which humans confront objects of nature and social relations, mediating between subject and object and thereby forming the classic foundation of human knowledge, cognition and culture. Because the activity is externally oriented, its outcome can be verified by an observer, which is precisely what makes learning from it possible at all.
description-chinese: 人面对自然物与社会关系对象、通过中介与客体相互作用的活动，构成人类知识与认知的经典基础。

name: overreliance on autopilot
label: education
description: A state in which the learner treats AI output as automatically correct and stops checking it, effectively leaving the verification loop while still believing themselves to be in control. The defining feature is the mismatch between actual checking behaviour and the learner's own confidence that checking is taking place.
description-chinese: 学习者将AI输出视为自动正确而停止核验、实际退出验证循环却自以为掌舵的状态。

name: overt strategy
label: education
description: A learning strategy that is consciously accessible to and can be verbalised by the learner, such as rehearsing a list aloud, in contrast to strategies executed without awareness. Because such strategies can be verbalised, taught deliberately and monitored, their availability is a prerequisite for conscious instruction in learning strategy use.
description-chinese: 学习者可自觉意识并能用言语陈述的学习策略，如出声复述列表。

name: parent-child dialogue
label: education
description: Verbal interaction between a caregiver and child in which questions, expansions and recasts are used to scaffold the child's utterance, and which is transcribed and coded for topic control, lexical sophistication and responsiveness in language-development research.
description-chinese: 照护者与儿童之间的言语互动，问句、扩展与重述用以支持儿童话语，常被转写编码用于语言发展研究。

name: pedagogical symbiosis
label: education
description: A pedagogical stance in which teacher and learner each retain irreducible expertise, and technology is designed to strengthen their joint practice rather than substitute for it. Its empirical signature is that unaided performance rises over time, rather than assisted performance rising while unsupported performance stagnates or declines.
description-chinese: 教师与学习者各自保有不可替代的专长、技术用于增强而非替代共同实践的教学立场。

name: picture description
label: education
description: A verbal elicitation task in which a participant describes an unfamiliar picture, requiring object identification, spatial and causal integration, and fluent sentence production, so it is widely used to sample spontaneous language from children and to screen for pragmatic impairment.
description-chinese: 受试者对陌生图片作口头描述的任务，需完成物体识别、空间与因果整合及流畅造句，常用于诱发儿童自发语言。

name: pointing
label: education
description: A communicative gesture extending an arm and index finger toward an object to share attention with a partner, discriminated from reaching by its communicative intent and from declarative pointing by its joint-attentional framing.
description-chinese: 伸出手臂与食指指向物体以与伙伴共享注意的交流手势，区别于取物动作与指示性指点。

name: post-human learner
label: education
description: A conception of the learner as distributed across biological, social and technical components, so that cognition is analysed as assembled rather than as located within an individual mind. Analyses conducted under this conception therefore target configurations of human and technical components rather than individuals understood in isolation.
description-chinese: 将学习者视为跨生物、社会与技术要素分布、认知为组装而成而非居于个体心智的构念。

name: practical activity
label: education
description: Goal-directed material and social activity through which humans transform objects and relations and, in doing so, transform themselves, forming the basis of cognition and of individual development. Historically this category carried the heaviest explanatory weight, since perception and cognition were understood as products of practical transformation of the world.
description-chinese: 有目的的物质与社会活动，人在其中改造客体与关系并改造自身，构成认知与发展的基础。

name: practical relation
label: education
description: The relation between subject and object grounded in material practice and labour, in which the human subject forms itself through transforming objects and the objective conditions of its activity. Because the object is materially resistant, activity with it supplies corrective feedback that pure reflection cannot provide.
description-chinese: 主体与客体之间以物质实践和劳动为基础的关系，人在改造客体与客观条件中塑造自身。

name: preschool
label: education
description: The developmental period preceding formal primary schooling, typically covering roughly ages three to six, when language, joint attention and self-regulation emerge rapidly and in which structured teaching of phonological awareness and numeracy has its largest effects.
description-chinese: 小学正式入学前的发展阶段，约三至六岁，语言、共同注意与自我调节迅速发展，语音意识与数感教学效应最大。

name: proxy failure
label: education
description: A breakdown in which an AI stand-in yields an answer diverging from what the learner would have produced, silently corrupting decisions that are credited to the learner. It is detected by comparing a learner's unaided performance against their supported performance over time, and is invisible to any measure taken only under support.
description-chinese: AI替代者的产出偏离学习者本可得出的结论、致归于学习者的判断被悄然污染的失效。

name: psychometrically-aware AI
name_cn: 心理测量学感知人工智能
label: education
description: An AI marking or tutoring system that explicitly models item difficulty, discrimination and learner ability instead of treating learner responses as unweighted tokens of text. Such systems can request missing evidence, abstain when data are insufficient, and calibrate confidence directly from the item parameters they estimate.
description-chinese: 显式建模题目难度、区分度与学习者能力而非将作答视为等权词元的AI评分或辅导系统。

name: qualitative assessment
label: education
description: Evaluation that interprets performance against qualitative descriptors rather than numerical scores, yielding narrative judgements about quality, reasoning quality and communicative competence. Reliability requires an explicit rubric and trained raters, otherwise the narrative register merely conveys unarticulated impression.
description-chinese: 以质性描述标准而非数值分数评判表现，形成关于质量、推理与沟通能力的叙述性判断。

name: question group abstraction
label: education
description: The treatment of several items sharing a stimulus or construct as one selectable unit in an adaptive or item-selection model, so that item counts and content balance are computed at the group rather than single-item level.
description-chinese: 把共享材料或构念的若干题目视为一个可选单元的建模抽象。

name: Rasch model
label: education
description: A single-parameter item response model asserting that the log-odds of success equals the difference between item difficulty and person ability, placing raw scores on an interval scale. Data that fit the model are described as sufficient and unidimensional, and systematic departures from fit indicate miscalibrated or biased items.
description-chinese: 假定成功几率的对数几率等于题目难度与个体能力之差、使原始分具备区间尺度的单参数模型。

name: rating scale
label: education
description: An ordered set of verbal or numeric response options along a single dimension, such as confidence, effort or fluency, on which a participant or judge places a case; unlike a rubric it does not decompose performance into separate criteria.
description-chinese: 沿单一维度排列的有序语言或数值选项，用于对某案例定位；与量规不同，不将表现分解为多个独立标准。

name: reasoning
label: education
description: The mental computation of drawing conclusions from premises or evidence, encompassing deductive, inductive and abductive forms, treated in learning science as a core component of higher-order thinking. Its quality is judged by the validity of the inference rather than by the fluency with which a conclusion is stated.
description-chinese: 由前提或证据得出结论的心理运算过程，包含演绎、归纳与溯源等基本形式。

name: referential speech
label: education
description: Utterances whose linguistic form is driven by an external referent such as an object, picture or person, judged on whether they direct the listener's attention appropriately; children with autism produce fewer referential utterances overall but similar quality.
description-chinese: 由物体、图画或人物等外部指称驱动的言语，判断其能否恰当地引导听者注意，为自闭症儿童早期语用发展的核心指标。

name: relational epistemic agency
label: education
description: The capacity to shape and take part in the production of knowledge together with others, where agency is construed as relational rather than as a possession of the individual. It is therefore assessed relationally, by examining how contributions are distributed across participants rather than by scoring individuals in isolation.
description-chinese: 在共同知识生产中塑造并参与知识生产的能动性，强调其关系性而非个体所有物属性。

name: reliance
label: education
description: The general disposition to accept and act upon an AI system's output without independent verification, treated as the baseline condition from which overreliance develops. Mild reliance is functionally normal in legitimate tasks, whereas unconditional reliance becomes pathological precisely when verification is warranted but omitted.
description-chinese: 未经独立核验即接受并据以行动的人工智能系统输出倾向。

name: responsible assessment
label: education
description: Assessment practice that makes the consequences of evaluation explicit, justifies its inferences, discloses the tools used and accepts accountability for harms and appeals. Its critics argue that such transparency raises the cost and time of assessment beyond what is feasible at scale, which is why adoption is uneven.
description-chinese: 明确评价后果、论证其推断、披露所用工具并对伤害与申诉负责的测评实践。

name: rubric
label: education
description: An explicit scoring instrument stating the performance criteria, their weighting and the level descriptors that distinguish an adequate response from an excellent one, used to make evaluative judgement transparent, reproducible and communicable between raters.
description-chinese: 列明评价标准、权重及区分合格与卓越的等级描述符的评分工具，使评价判断透明、可复现且可沟通。

name: rubric-based grading
label: education
description: Grading against explicit analytic criteria whose levels are defined and calibrated in advance, making individual judgements auditable and comparable across markers and cohorts. Reliability nevertheless remains bounded by how reliably the underlying performance dimension can be observed in the first place, rubric notwithstanding.
description-chinese: 依据事先设定并校准等级的评分量规判分，使个别评判可审查且跨评分者可比。

name: sample stimulus
label: education
description: An item presented before the critical trials of an experiment to demonstrate the required response contingency, such as a practice picture before eye-tracking trials, allowing the participant to discover the mapping between stimulus and expected response.
description-chinese: 在关键试次前呈现以演示刺激与预期反应对应关系的示例项目，如眼动实验中的练习图片。

name: self-evaluations
label: education
cite-abstract: Student self-assessment occurs when learners make judgements about aspects of their own performance. This paper focuses on one aspect of quantitative self-assessments: the comparison of student-generated marks with those generated by teachers. Studies including such comparisons in the context of higher education courses are reviewed and the following questions are addressed: (i) do students tend to over- or under-rate themselves vis-á-vis teachers?, (ii) do students of different abilities have the same tendencies?, (iii) do students in different kinds or levels of course tend to under- or over-rate themselves?, (iv) do students improve their ability to rate themselves over time or with practice?, (v) are the same tendencies evident when self-marks are used for formal assessment purposes?, and (vi) are there gender differences in self-rating?
description: Judgements in which learners rate their own mastery, confidence or strategy quality rather than that of peers; they are cheap and scalable but require calibration checks, since self-ratings are only weakly to moderately correlated with actual performance.
description-chinese: 学习者对自身掌握度、信心或策略质量的判断而非对同伴的评价；成本低且易扩展，但需做校准检验。

name: SES
label: education
description: A composite index of household income, parental educational attainment and occupational prestige, used as the principal stratifier for explaining disparities in educational attainment, access and outcomes across populations. Because it bundles economic, cultural and social capital together, the construct is frequently criticized for masking which particular component drives observed differences.
description-chinese: 由家庭收入、父母受教育程度与职业声望构成的复合指标，是解释教育成就差异的主要分层变量。

name: shallow adaptivity
label: education
description: System behaviour that adapts only superficial parameters such as difficulty numbers or pacing while leaving the underlying content representation and learner model fixed, giving the appearance without the substance of personalization.
description-chinese: 仅调整难度或节奏而内容表征与学习者模型不变的自适应行为。

name: shared reading
label: education
description: A joint reading activity in which an adult and child attend simultaneously to the same print and illustrations, with the adult providing increasingly active support, shown to be associated with emergent literacy such as print awareness and vocabulary growth.
description-chinese: 成人与儿童共处同一文本与图像的协同阅读活动，成人支持随时间递减，与词汇与印刷意识等早期读写能力相关。

name: smart campus
label: education
description: A campus whose teaching, management and service functions are integrated through networked sensing, unified identity and shared data platforms, enabling context-aware and responsive institutional operation. Such integration raises governance questions about proportionality of monitoring and about the boundaries between pedagogical data and personnel data.
description-chinese: 通过联网感知、统一身份与数据平台整合教学、管理与服务功能的校园形态，实现情境感知的校务运行。

name: smart management platform
label: education
description: An institutional software platform consolidating administrative processes such as attendance, scheduling, resource booking, asset management and safety monitoring into a single unified operational interface. Centralization improves consistency of decision records, though it also concentrates authority and creates a single point of operational failure.
description-chinese: 将考勤、排课、资源预约与安全监测等校务流程整合到统一操作界面的校级软件平台。

name: smart outdoor environment
label: education
description: Outdoor campus space instrumented with sensing and signage so that weather, air quality and pedestrian flows inform activity scheduling, emergency response and routine safety decisions. Deployments must balance utility against data collection proportionality, since persistent outdoor sensing of minors carries distinct ethical weight.
description-chinese: 布设传感与标识装置的校园户外空间，使天气、空气质量与人流状况为活动安排与安全决策提供依据。

name: smart security
label: education
description: Campus safety management combining access control, video analytics and perimeter alerting to detect intrusion, bullying and other hazards, with human intervention required for every consequential alert. Automated detection carries false positive rates that require calibrated thresholds and a clear protocol for human adjudication of every flagged event.
description-chinese: 结合门禁、视频分析与周界告警的校园安全管理，用于识别入侵、欺凌等隐患，并对告警实施人工干预。

name: smart teaching assistant
label: education
description: An AI-augmented assistant that supports instruction by circulating among students, answering procedural and logistical questions, and supplying aggregated diagnostic feedback to the teacher in real time. Its pedagogical value depends on whether it withholds answers when withholding is instructionally appropriate, a distinction poorly captured by ordinary question answering.
description-chinese: 在学生间巡走、解答流程性问题并向教师提供诊断性反馈以支持课堂教学的AI助教。

name: smart teaching environment
label: education
description: A physically and digitally equipped classroom in which devices, sensors and platforms adapt lighting, seating, display and interaction affordances to the instructional situation unfolding at that moment. Affordances are pedagogical only insofar as they serve the instructional objective, otherwise they introduce attentional competition rather than support.
description-chinese: 在物理与数字双重装备下，使设备、传感器与平台依当下教学情境自适应调节灯光、座位、显示与互动的教室。

name: social disengagement
label: education
description: A deficit-model construct describing reduced social motivation, such as diminished reward value of social interaction, lowered preference for faces and reduced social engagement with peers, contrasted with theory-of-mind accounts of autism.
description-chinese: 描述社会动机降低的缺陷模型构念，含社交互动的奖赏价值下降、对面孔偏好的减弱等，与心智理论解释相对。

name: social learning theory
label: education
description: The theory that learning occurs primarily through observation of models and vicarious reinforcement, explaining acquisition of aggression, gender roles and complex skills without any direct reinforcement of the learner. Subsequent evidence qualifies the account, showing that observational learning can produce behaviour that is never subsequently reinforced.
description-chinese: 主张学习主要通过观察榜样与替代性强化实现，用以解释攻击行为与性别角色等无需直接强化即可习得。

name: social use of communication
label: education
description: The communicative-intent construct operationalised through eye contact, communicative intention, initiation and reciprocal interaction, and used to gauge the social-communicative motivation of children with autism beyond what grammatical accuracy alone reveals about interaction quality.
description-chinese: 通过眼神接触、交际意图、发起与往复互动等指标刻画儿童的社会交际动机，超出单纯语法正确性所能反映的范围。

name: social use of language
label: education
cite-bibtex-full:
@incollection{hymes1972communicative,
  author = {Hymes, Dell},
  title = {On Communicative Competence},
  booktitle = {Sociolinguistics: Selected Readings},
  editor = {Pride, J. B. and Holmes, Janet},
  publisher = {Penguin Education},
  address = {Harmondsworth},
  pages = {269--293},
  year = {1972},
  note = {book/no-abstract}
}
description: The pragmatic dimension of language covering communicative intent, turn-taking and repair, distinguishing utterances that are grammatical but socially inappropriate from those that are both, assessed in children suspected of autism spectrum disorder.
description-chinese: 语言的社会语用维度，涉及交际意图、话轮转换与修复，区分语法正确但社交不当的话语。

name: specialized intelligent classroom
label: education
description: A purpose-built classroom integrating smart blackboards, automated recording and broadcasting, and interaction systems, configured for one particular teaching mode such as lecture, discussion or hybrid delivery. The recording capability simultaneously supports review and generates privacy obligations concerning the students captured on camera without individual consent.
description-chinese: 为某一特定教学模式整合智慧黑板、录播、广播与互动系统而专门建设的教室。

name: STEM教育
label: education
description: An integrated curriculum combining science, technology, engineering and mathematics so that concepts from the four domains are applied jointly to authentic problems. Integration is realised through project tasks that require all four domains simultaneously, rather than by bolting topics onto separately taught subjects.
description-chinese: 把科学、技术、工程与数学整合为课程、使四域概念共同应用于真实问题的教育模式。

name: storytelling
label: education
description: The oral production of an organised sequence of events with a protagonist, goal and resolution, requiring planning, cohesion and perspective maintenance; children's spontaneous storytelling is analysed for narrative structure, mood shifts and evaluative commentary.
description-chinese: 围绕主角、目标与结局组织事件序列的口头叙述行为，需具备计划、衔接与视角维持能力。

name: structural understanding
label: education
description: Comprehension of the relational structure organizing a domain, enabling learners to explain why phenomena occur and to predict what follows, rather than merely to recall that a fact is the case.
description-chinese: 对组织某领域之关系结构的理解，使学习者能解释现象何以发生而非仅记忆其曾经发生。

name: subject-based lesson preparation
label: education
description: Preparation organized by school subject discipline, aligning objectives, key and difficult points, teaching methods and assessment tasks within the established conventions of that subject community. Discipline-based framing preserves the specialized methods and representational conventions that later interdisciplinary work depends upon.
description-chinese: 按学校学科组织进行的备课，在该学科共同体内部对齐目标、重难点、方法与评价。

name: subjectivity
label: education
description: The capacity of a subject to take an attitude toward objects and to constitute itself as the origin of action and knowledge, central to discussions of human agency, autonomy and personal formation.
description-chinese: 主体对对象采取态度并建构自身为行动与知识之源的能力，是讨论能动性与自主性的核心。

name: superior temporal gyrus
label: education
description: A gyral region of the temporal lobe containing primary and association auditory areas and multisensory face-responsive regions, whose activation during speech and social tasks is repeatedly reported as atypical in autism spectrum disorder.
description-chinese: 颞叶脑回，含听觉皮层与面孔反应的多感官联合区，在言语与社会任务中的激活在自闭症群体中被反复报告为异常。

name: System One
label: education
description: The fast, automatic and largely unconscious processing system that generates intuitive impressions without deliberate effort in the dual-process account of cognition. It is characterised by automaticity, parallel processing and affective rather than deliberative control, and is therefore difficult to introspect or override.
description-chinese: 双加工理论中快速、自动且基本无意识的加工系统，凭直觉即时生成判断。

name: System Two
label: education
description: The slow, effortful and conscious processing system of dual-process theory, which supports analytical reasoning, self-monitoring and the deliberate revision of intuitive judgements. Because it is effortful, serial in character and largely unavailable under time pressure or high cognitive load, its operations are typically experienced as effort.
description-chinese: 双加工理论中缓慢、费力且有意识的加工系统，支持分析推理、自我监控与直觉修正。

name: systems of inference
label: education
description: The structured and largely implicit rules by which members of a community move from evidence to accepted claims, encoding which inferences count as legitimate. Systems of inference therefore differ across disciplines, and even where the same inferential form is invoked the warranting conditions attached to it will differ.
description-chinese: 共同体成员由证据走向公认主张的隐含规则体系，规定何种推断被视为合法。

name: thinking
label: education
description: The higher-order intellectual activity of operating on representations in order to solve problems, evaluate alternatives and produce new knowledge, distinguished from sensation, perception and simple memory. Distinguishing thought from perception matters pedagogically, since only the former is typically available for explicit verbalization and conscious error correction.
description-chinese: 对表象进行运算以解决问题、产生新知识的高阶智力活动，有别于感觉、知觉与记忆。

name: topic mastery
label: education
description: The degree to which a learner has integrated the key concepts, procedures and characteristic misconceptions of a bounded domain of content, as estimated from their responses. It is commonly operationalised through item-level response models calibrated against a domain-specific item bank rather than by a single aggregate test score.
description-chinese: 学习者对某一内容领域关键概念、程序与典型误解的整合程度。

name: truth condition
label: education
description: The condition specifying the circumstances under which a sentence or proposition is true, used by analytic philosophers to clarify the content of knowledge claims before assessing whether the claim actually holds.
description-chinese: 规定一个句子或命题为真所需满足之条件，分析哲学用以在评估主张之前澄清知识主张的内容。

name: truthful assertion
label: education
description: A speech act whose propositional content is asserted as true by the speaker, engaging the speaker's epistemic responsibility even in cases where the assertion ultimately proves false or unfounded. The speaker is ordinarily taken to have a duty to verify the assertion, and failure to do so becomes evidentially relevant to later belief formation.
description-chinese: 说话者以其内容为真而加以断言的言语行为，即使断言终归为假仍引发说话者的认识论责任。

name: Tutor CoPilot
label: education
cite-abstract: Generative AI, particularly Language Models (LMs), has the potential to transform real-world domains with societal impact, particularly where access to experts is limited. For example, in education, training novice educators with expert guidance is important for effectiveness but expensive, creating significant barriers to improving education quality at scale. This challenge disproportionately harms students from under-served communities, who stand to gain the most from high-quality education. We introduce Tutor CoPilot, a novel Human-AI approach that leverages a model of expert thinking to provide expert-like guidance to tutors as they tutor. This study is the first randomized controlled trial of a Human-AI system in live tutoring, involving 900 tutors and 1,800 K-12 students from historically under-served communities. Following a preregistered analysis plan, we find that students working with tutors that have access to Tutor CoPilot are 4 percentage points (p.p.) more likely to master topics (p<0.01). Notably, students of lower-rated tutors experienced the greatest benefit, improving mastery by 9 p.p. We find that Tutor CoPilot costs only $20 per-tutor annually. We analyze 550,000+ messages using classifiers to identify pedagogical strategies, and find that tutors with access to Tutor CoPilot are more likely to use high-quality strategies to foster student understanding (e.g., asking guiding questions) and less likely to give away the answer to the student. Tutor interviews highlight how Tutor CoPilot's guidance helps tutors to respond to student needs, though they flag issues in Tutor CoPilot, such as generating suggestions that are not grade-level appropriate. Altogether, our study of Tutor CoPilot demonstrates how Human-AI systems can scale expertise in real-world domains, bridge gaps in skills and create a future where high-quality education is accessible to all students.
description: A retrieval-augmented assistant that surfaces vetted teaching moves and resources to human tutors in real time, aiming to scale instructional expertise in under-served classrooms. Retrieval is deliberately restricted to curated corpora so that the suggestions it surfaces remain defensible, attributable and acceptable under institutional review.
description-chinese: 实时为人类教师提供经筛选的教学策略与资源的检索增强助手，用于扩大师资薄弱课堂的指导能力。

name: unit-based lesson preparation
label: education
description: Designing instruction around an integrated thematic unit rather than isolated lessons, so that shared objectives, sequenced activities and cumulative assessment opportunities are planned coherently together. The unit frame encourages connections across lessons, but only if shared objectives are stated in terms students can actually act upon.
description-chinese: 以整合的主题单元而非孤立课时设计教学，将共同目标、活动序列与累积性评价统筹规划。

name: visual attention
label: education
cite-abstract: A new hypothesis about the role of focused attention is proposed. The feature-integration theory of attention suggests that attention must be directed serially to each stimulus in a display whenever conjunctions of more than one separable feature are needed to characterize or distinguish the possible objects presented. A number of predictions were tested in a variety of paradigms including visual search, texture segregation, identification and localization, and using both separable dimensions (shape and color) and local elements or parts of figures (lines, curves, etc. in letters) as the features to be integrated into complex wholes. The results were in general consistent with the hypothesis. They offer a new set of criteria for distinguishing separable from integral features and a new rationale for predicting which tasks will show attention limits and which will not.
description: The allocation of limited cognitive processing resources to selected regions or features of a visual scene, measured experimentally through reaction time, accuracy, or eye-movement patterns, and shown to be refined during development as children learn to encode faces and objects.
description-chinese: 将有限认知资源分配到视觉场景特定区域或特征的心理加工过程，可由反应时、准确率与眼动模式测量。

name: vocabulary
label: education
description: The breadth and depth of lexical knowledge a learner possesses, typically measured as number of distinct word types produced or understood; breadth predicts reading comprehension, while depth predicts how readily novel words are learned.
description-chinese: 学习者拥有的词汇知识广度与深度，常以不同词型的产出的数量衡量；广度预测阅读理解，深度预测新词学习速度。

name: volitional activity
label: education
description: Mental activity directed toward purposeful goals, involving intention, sustained striving and inhibition of competing impulses in the pursuit of regulated and deliberate action rather than reflexive reaction. Its exercise requires sustained inhibition of competing responses, making it acutely vulnerable to the attentional demands of the learning task itself.
description-chinese: 以预定目的为指向的心理活动，包含意图、持续努力以及对竞争性冲动的抑制。

name: well-defined problem
label: education
cite-abstract: The boundary between well structured and ill structured problems is vague, fluid and not susceptible to formalization. Any problem solving process will appear ill structured if the problem solver is a serial machine that has access to a very large long-term memory of potentially relevant information, and/or access to a very large external memory that provides information about the actual real-world consequences of problem-solving actions. There is no reason to suppose that new and hitherto unknown concepts or techniques are needed to enable artificial intelligence systems to operate successfully in domains that have these characteristics.
description: A problem whose goal state, permissible solution operators and the mapping from initial state to goal are fully specified, so a correct solution can in principle be derived by search rather than interpretive judgment.
description-chinese: 目标状态、可用操作及其与初始状态的映射完全明确，可由搜索求解的问题。

name: 一体化顶层设计
label: education
description: Planning in which infrastructure, platform, application and governance are specified as one coordinated whole, so that isolated projects avoid making mutually incompatible technical commitments. Integrated planning is difficult institutionally because it requires reconciling departmental interests before any visible deliverable exists.
description-chinese: 将基建、平台、应用与治理作为一个协调整体进行规划，避免孤立项目作出互不兼容的承诺。

name: 不可替代学习
label: education
description: Learning that must occur without delegation because it constitutes the capability being assessed, as opposed to procedural learning that can legitimately be outsourced to a tool.
description-chinese: 因构成受评能力本身而必须由学习者亲自完成、不可外代的学习。

name: 不可替代性
label: education
description: The degree to which a teaching function cannot be performed by current AI, argued from situated judgment, ethical accountability and relationships rather than from task complexity. Argument from situated judgement and relationship succeeds only if the account specifies what such judgement consists in.
description-chinese: 某教学功能无法由当前AI承担的程度，其论证依据为情境判断、伦理责任与关系而非任务复杂度。

name: 临床经验
label: education
description: Accumulated practitioner judgment from repeated case contact, valued for pattern recognition in ambiguous presentations while remaining vulnerable to confirmation bias and to drift from population evidence.
description-chinese: 从业者通过反复个案积累的模式识别判断力，易受确认偏差影响。

name: 主题教学
label: education
description: 以一个统领性的真实问题或主题统整若干学科内容组织教学的设计取向，学习活动围绕主题驱动而非按课时逐项讲授，其难点在学科知识在主题线索下的重新编码。
description-chinese: 以统领性真实问题统整多学科内容组织教学的设计取向，活动围绕主题驱动，难点在学科知识的主题化编码。

name: 云教研
label: education
description: Teacher professional development conducted through cloud platforms, aggregating lesson observation, structured annotation and asynchronous discussion across schools, regions and subject communities. Platform-mediated observation can standardize the criteria of good practice, which improves consistency while constraining pedagogical diversity.
description-chinese: 借助云平台开展的教师专业发展，跨校跨区域汇聚听课、标注与研讨活动。

name: 云课堂
label: education
description: Instruction delivered through a cloud platform combining live broadcasting with real-time interaction and replayable resources, extending classroom access and participation beyond physical space and time. The principal constraint is not transmission bandwidth but interaction design, since live video alone provides little more than a recorded lecture unless it is accompanied by meaningful participation structures.
description-chinese: 通过云平台将直播与互动、可回放资源相结合的教学方式，将课堂延展至物理空间之外。

name: 互动课件
label: education
description: Courseware embedding interactive tasks, branching and immediate feedback so that learner responses shape subsequent content rather than following a fixed linear script. Branch design requires accurate prediction of learner choices, and mispredicted branches leave learners stranded in dead ends.
description-chinese: 内嵌互动任务、分支与即时反馈的课件，学习者反应可影响后续内容而非依循固定线性脚本。

name: 五育
label: education
description: The policy framework integrating moral, intellectual, physical, aesthetic and labour education as inseparable and mutually reinforcing dimensions of holistic personal development. The framework is curricular in aspiration but frequently uneven in implementation, since assessment systems tend to privilege the intellectual dimension.
description-chinese: 将德育、智育、体育、美育与劳育作为不可分割的全面发展维度相整合的政策框架。

name: 交叉科学
label: education
description: Research conducted at the intersection of two or more disciplines in which concepts, methods or instruments are genuinely exchanged rather than merely juxtaposed. Its governance requires funding and evaluation criteria that reward genuinely novel combinations of methods rather than incremental work within a single home discipline.
description-chinese: 在两门以上学科交叉处开展、真正交换概念方法工具而非简单并列拼接的研究。

name: 产学研融合
label: education
description: 高校、产业与研究机构在人才培养、科研攻关与成果转化上形成稳定协作机制的组织安排，其有效性取决于是否存在持续的共同项目与人员双向流动。
description-chinese: 高校、产业与研究机构在人才培养、科研与成果转化上形成稳定协作的组织安排，取决于持续的共同项目与人员流动。

name: 人工智能+教育
label: education
description: The application of artificial intelligence technologies to the processes of teaching, learning and educational administration, spanning data-driven support and system-level integration. Institutional adoption depends as much on teacher workload, procurement and governance arrangements as on the measured accuracy of the underlying models.
description-chinese: 将人工智能技术用于教学、学习与教育管理全过程的实践，涵盖数据支持与系统级整合。

name: 人才培养模式
label: education
description: The institutional arrangement through which abilities are formed, specifying the sequence of general and specialised study, the placement of practice, and the mechanisms used to certify attainment.
description-chinese: 规定通识与专修学习次序、实践环节与达成认定的育人制度安排。

name: 人机共创
label: education
description: 学习者与生成式系统在同一产出任务上交替贡献与相互修订的协作模式，其成效取决于分工是否互补：人负责目标设定与价值判断，模型负责变体生成。
description-chinese: 学习者与生成式系统在产出任务上交替贡献与修订的协作模式，成效取决于人负责目标与价值判断的互补分工。

name: 人机共教
label: education
description: 人类教师与智能系统在同一课堂中共同承担教学职能的协作形态，研究关注的不只是效率提升，还包括教师角色被重新界定为学习设计者与关系维护者。
description-chinese: 人类教师与智能系统在同一课堂共同承担教学职能的形态，教师角色被重界定为学习设计者与关系维护者。

name: 人机共构
label: education
description: A collaborative mode in which human and machine contributions are interwoven through repeated generation, critique and revision, producing artefacts neither could achieve alone. Ownership of the resulting artefact becomes ambiguous, which makes the provenance and attribution of contributions a central governance question.
description-chinese: 人机贡献经由生成、批评与修订反复交织、产出单一方无法达成的成果的协作模式。

name: 人机协同中的教师角色
name_cn: 人机协同中的教师角色
label: education
description: Reconceptualization of the teacher in AI-integrated classrooms as designer of tasks, assessor of evidence and guarantor of values rather than as primary transmitter of content. The reframing shifts professional accountability toward judgement about evidence and consequences, which is precisely the expertise least amenable to automation.
description-chinese: 在AI融入的课堂中把教师重新界定为任务设计者、证据评估者与价值担保者，而非内容的主要传递者。

name: 人机协同结构
label: education
description: The explicit allocation of roles and decision rights between person and system in a task process, documented so that responsibility and required judgement are known before the work begins.
description-chinese: 任务流程中人与系统的角色与决策权分配，并事先明确责任。

name: 人类知识
label: education
description: The full stock of propositions and skills a society holds, distinguished by ownership and access rather than by amount, so that gaps in use are problems of transmission rather than deficit.
description-chinese: 社会所拥有的命题与技能存量，其问题多在传递与获取而非存量不足。

name: 任务态
label: education
description: The recording window during which a participant performs the prescribed interaction or task, contrasted with resting or baseline periods, requiring matched duration and conditions for comparison.
description-chinese: 被试执行规定任务期间的记录时段，与静息或基线时段相对照。

name: 任务态基线
label: education
description: A pre-task recording window used to establish per-participant reference values, since between-subject differences in resting signal would otherwise be mistaken for task-related change.
description-chinese: 任务开始前记录的参照时段，用以校正个体差异避免误判任务效应。

name: 任务表现
label: education
description: The observed quality of execution on a specific task, measured as accuracy, speed or completeness, which stands in contrast to underlying competence. Because any single observation samples rather than exhausts the underlying capacity, repeated trials are required and sampling error must be modelled explicitly.
description-chinese: 在特定任务上的执行质量，以准确性、速度或完整性衡量，与潜在胜任相对。

name: 仿真
label: education
description: The construction of a reproducible artificial environment whose relevant structural features match a real system so that policies or interventions can be tested cheaply and repeatedly before deployment.
description-chinese: 构建结构上匹配真实系统、可低成本反复试验策略的人工环境。

name: 传统学习分析
label: education
description: 以结构化日志、测验与问卷数据描述学生表现与参与度的分析范式，其结论通常停留在描述与群体统计层面，不直接产生可执行的干预决策。
description-chinese: 以结构化日志、测验与问卷数据描述表现与参与度的分析范式，结论多停留在描述与群体统计层面。

name: 传统心理测量
label: education
description: Classical test theory practice in which a fixed instrument yields a single static score interpreted against a norm group, assuming measurement invariance across administrations. Its assumptions are increasingly strained by adaptive item selection and by item formats whose difficulty depends on context or on the examinee's state.
description-chinese: 以固定工具产生单一静态分数并对照常模解释、假定各次测量等值的经典测验理论实践。

name: 伦理关系
label: education
description: The dimension of educational activity in which values, norms, and obligations among participants are negotiated, which cannot be reduced to instrumental efficiency and sets limits on what may legitimately be optimized.
description-chinese: 教育活动中协商价值、规范与义务、不可化约为工具效率的维度。

name: 信息化
label: education
description: The earlier stage of educational digitalization centred on introducing information technology, devices and software into teaching practice, without yet restructuring processes around data and evidence. The characteristic failure of this stage is what digital technology research calls the substitution of old routines for old routines in new form.
description-chinese: 教育数字化的较早阶段，重在将信息技术与设备引入教学，尚未围绕数据重构流程。

name: 做中学
label: education
description: The pedagogical doctrine that understanding is constructed through purposeful activity and its consequences rather than acquired by passively receiving transmitted knowledge. The doctrine implies that activity must be purposefully structured, since unstructured activity generates experience without necessarily producing understanding.
description-chinese: 主张理解经由有目的的活动及其后果建构而成，而非通过被动接受被传递的知识而习得。

name: 儿童具身学习
label: education
description: Learning in which children construct understanding through whole-body perception, movement and interaction with the material environment rather than through symbolic explanation alone. Physical engagement is argued to support abstraction, spatial reasoning and durable retention, though the mechanism and the necessary dosage remain contested.
description-chinese: 儿童通过全身感知、动作与对环境的交互建构理解、而非仅靠符号讲解的学习方式。

name: 公共卫生
label: education
description: The discipline concerned with population-level prevention, surveillance, and policy, supplying the prevalence estimates and burden measures against which individual clinical or educational claims are calibrated.
description-chinese: 关注人群层面预防、监测与政策的学科，为流行率与疾病负担提供依据。

name: 关键教学行为
label: education
description: 经实证研究确证与学生理解相关、可作为课堂观察编码单元的具体教学动作，如等待时间、提问分布与反馈类型，其识别依赖编码者间一致性检验。
description-chinese: 经实证确证与学生理解相关、可作为课堂观察编码单元的教学动作，如等待时间与提问分布。

name: 关键能力
label: education
description: 指在某一领域内决定后续学习效率、并可在不同任务情境中迁移的高阶能力成分，其识别须通过任务要求的受控变化来排除知识特异性解释。
description-chinese: 决定后续学习效率并可跨情境迁移的高阶能力成分，识别需通过任务要求的受控变化排除知识特异性解释。

name: 兴奋与抑制
label: education
description: The opposing processes whose relative balance determines whether neural activity is enhanced or suppressed, central to accounts of excitation, reinforcement, and the limits of additional stimulation.
description-chinese: 共同决定神经活动增强或抑制的相反过程，是解释强化与刺激饱和的基础。

name: 典型发展对照组
label: education
description: Participants without developmental diagnosis who provide the normative comparison against which group differences in behaviour or neural response are interpreted, matched on variables unrelated to the effect.
description-chinese: 无发育诊断问题、与实验组在无关变量上匹配的参照参与者。

name: 决策模型
label: education
description: A formal specification mapping observed states to chosen actions, used to make the logic of educational or administrative choices inspectable and to permit counterfactual analysis of alternatives.
description-chinese: 把观察状态映射到具体行动的规范模型，使决策逻辑可检视。

name: 分组活动
label: education
description: 将班级划分为小组并赋予协同任务与角色分工的教学组织形式，其学习效应高度依赖是否同时施加个人责任 accountability 与组内相互解释要求。
description-chinese: 将班级划分为小组并赋予协同任务与角色分工的组织形式，效应取决于是否施加个人责任与组内解释要求。

name: 刻板行为
label: education
description: Purposeless motor or vocal behaviour occurring in a fixed repetitive form, assessed along the dimensions of duration, number of units per episode, and interference with other ongoing activity.
description-chinese: 无目的、以固定重复形式出现的动作或发声行为，按时长与干扰度评估。

name: 动态心理表征
label: education
description: A model of the learner as a continuously updated state estimated from an ongoing stream of interaction data rather than as a fixed trait measured at one moment. Stability and responsiveness must be balanced so that the state estimate is neither frozen into irrelevance nor driven by interaction noise.
description-chinese: 把学习者视为由持续交互数据流不断更新的状态、而非某一时点测得的固定特质的模型。

name: 动态数字画像
label: education
description: A continually updated multi-source representation of a learner, refreshed as new interaction data accumulate rather than fixed at a single assessment point or reporting period. Frequent updating risks oscillating conclusions on noisy evidence, so update frequency must be matched to the stability of the underlying construct.
description-chinese: 随新交互数据到来而不断更新的多来源学习者表征，而非固定于某一次测评时点。

name: 协同育人
label: education
description: A governance arrangement in which school, family and community share responsibility for developmental goals, coordinating distinct and complementary contributions rather than merely transferring tasks. Genuine sharing of responsibility requires institutional mechanisms, since informal consultation tends to preserve the school's unilateral authority in practice.
description-chinese: 学校、家庭与社区共担发展目标的治理安排，协调各自贡献而非简单移交任务。

name: 单元整体教学
label: education
description: 以学段目标统整单元内课时设计、使各课时指向同一进阶线索的教学组织方式，其前提是对单元文本的课程价值排序与课时间的内容逻辑重构。
description-chinese: 以学段目标统整单元课时设计、使各课时指向同一进阶线索的组织方式，前提是单元内容价值排序与逻辑重构。

name: 单元集体备课
label: education
description: 同学科教师围绕同一单元共同设计目标、活动与作业并统一进度标准的教研活动形式，其收益在于跨教师知识共享，风险在于降低课堂的因材施教空间。
description-chinese: 同学科教师围绕同一单元共同设计目标、活动与作业的教研形式，收益在知识共享，风险在压缩因材施教空间。

name: 参与度
label: education
description: The degree of behavioural, emotional and cognitive investment of learners in a task, with cognitive engagement distinguished from merely compliant participation. Behavioural measures can register compliance without any underlying investment, so cognitive engagement requires distinct and independent evidence.
description-chinese: 学习者在任务中的行为、情感与认知投入程度，其中心智投入须区别于仅顺从的参与。

name: 发展模拟
label: education
description: The use of simulation to project how a learner, cohort, or institution would change over time under specified assumptions, employed to explore consequences of an intervention before it is implemented.
description-chinese: 在给定假设下模拟学习者或机构随时间变化以预判干预后果。

name: 可复现研究证据
label: education
description: Findings published with sufficient materials, code, and procedural detail for an independent team to re-run the analysis and obtain the reported result, distinguishing evidential strength from statistical significance.
description-chinese: 提供足够材料与代码使独立团队可复现结果的研究证据。

name: 可计算性
label: education
description: The degree to which an educational construct admits stable operational definition and repeatable quantification, a precondition for evidence-based evaluation. Constructs that resist stable operationalization tend to be captured by proxies whose validity is then quietly assumed rather than demonstrated.
description-chinese: 某一教育构念能够被稳定操作化定义并可重复计量的程度，是循证评价的前提条件。

name: 因材施教
label: education
description: The long-standing pedagogical principle that instruction should be matched to the learner's current level and character, historically realized through differentiation and increasingly through adaptive systems.
description-chinese: 教学应与学习者当前水平与特点相匹配的教育原则。

name: 在线学习诊断
label: education
description: 在自然学习情境中依据答题与交互数据实时推断学习者知识状态与薄弱环节的方法，需在诊断准确度与测量开销之间取舍，常以IRT或认知诊断模型为内核。
description-chinese: 依据自然情境下答题与交互数据实时推断知识状态与薄弱环节的方法，常以IRT或认知诊断模型为内核。

name: 基线
label: education
description: The reference condition or measurement taken before manipulation or task engagement, against which subsequent values are expressed as change, and on which the validity of that comparison depends.
description-chinese: 干预或任务开始前所测得的参照条件，后续变化以此为基准。

name: 多主体协同教学
label: education
description: Teaching in which teachers, learners, AI systems and other stakeholders hold differentiated roles and coordinate their contributions toward a shared instructional goal. Effective coordination requires explicit handoff protocols, because ambiguity about who is authorised to decide reliably produces collective inaction.
description-chinese: 教师、学习者、AI系统等主体承担差异化角色并协同贡献于共同教学目标的组织方式。

name: 多场景仿真
label: education
description: Simulation repeated across configurations such as learner prior knowledge, error rates, and tool reliability, to test whether an intervention holds when the surrounding conditions are varied.
description-chinese: 在先备知识、错误率与工具可靠性等不同条件下反复开展仿真。

name: 多模态探究
label: education
description: Inquiry in which learners express and test hypotheses across text, image, sound, and interactive artefacts, supported by systems that generate and transform representations on demand.
description-chinese: 学习者在文本、图像、声音与交互产物间表达并检验假设的探究。

name: 大传统
label: education
description: In the history of education, the inherited scholarly ideal of disciplined, cumulative, and criticism-respecting inquiry, contrasted with the anti-traditional presentism characteristic of many reform movements.
description-chinese: 教育史中倡导严谨累积与批判的继承性学术传统。

name: 大学组织形态
label: education
description: The governance and unit structure through which a university operates, from disciplinary departments and tenure hierarchies to project teams and platform units that cut across departments.
description-chinese: 大学运行所依托的治理与单元结构形态。

name: 大学组织理念
label: education
description: The normative commitments about what a university is for, such as producing scholars, serving society, or cultivating individuals, which silently determine curricular and assessment decisions.
description-chinese: 关于大学为何存在的规范性承诺，隐性决定课程与评价取向。

name: 学业水平
label: education
description: The demonstrated attainment of specified learning outcomes against grade-level expectations, distinguished from potential capability or from self-reported confidence. Level designations are relative to grade-level expectations, so they support comparison within a system far better than across systems or curricula.
description-chinese: 对照年级预期已达成特定学习成果的实证水平，有别于潜在能力或自我报告的信心。

name: 学业认同
label: education
description: The extent to which a learner identifies with being a capable student in a particular subject, shaping effort, persistence and willingness to seek help. Identity is domain-specific, so strong identification in one subject may coexist with active avoidance of another.
description-chinese: 学习者在特定学科上认同自己是胜任学生的程度，影响努力、坚持与求助意愿。

name: 学业评价
label: education
description: The systematic judging of learning achievement against stated educational objectives, covering both formative feedback and summative certification functions. Purposive alignment requires curriculum and assessment to be designed jointly, since assessment inevitably drives what is actually taught.
description-chinese: 对照既定教育目标系统判定学习成就，兼具形成性反馈与终结性认证两种功能。

name: 学业负担
label: education
description: The total time, cognitive demand and homework volume imposed on learners, evaluated together with available rest and recovery time to judge whether it is excessive. Evaluating burden requires distinguishing total time from its distribution, since poorly timed and inefficiently structured homework is disproportionately costly.
description-chinese: 施加于学习者的总时间、认知要求与作业量，需结合可支配休息时间评估其是否过量。

name: 学业质量
label: education
description: The standard describing the knowledge, skills and dispositions learners should demonstrate, used to judge whether curricular goals have actually been achieved. Standards are only meaningful relative to the curriculum and opportunity provided, making quality claims frequently relative rather than absolute.
description-chinese: 规定学习者应达到的知识、技能与素养水平之标准，用以判断课程目标是否真正实现。

name: 学习习惯
label: education
description: Automatically triggered behavioural routines of study such as regular review and scheduled practice, formed by repetition and strongly resistant to change. Forming routines is easier than dissolving them, which is why established ineffective habits often persist despite official exhortation.
description-chinese: 经重复训练形成、由线索自动触发的学习行为常规，如定期复习与计划性练习，稳定性强。

name: 学习兴趣
label: education
description: A motivational disposition of sustained attention and re-engagement with subject matter, distinct from momentary enjoyment and from extrinsic reward seeking. Interest is domain-specific and largely developable, supporting instructional designs that build competence and relevance together.
description-chinese: 对学科内容保持持续专注并反复投入的动机倾向，区别于短暂愉悦与外在奖励寻求。

name: 学习力
label: education
description: A composite construct describing the general capacity to engage in and sustain learning, incorporating motivation, strategy repertoire, and persistence rather than accumulated subject knowledge or test scores.
description-chinese: 包含动机、策略储备与坚持性的整体学习能力构念。

name: 学习情绪
label: education
description: Emotions arising in learning situations, such as curiosity, frustration or anxiety, which condition attention and strategy use and therefore influence achievement. Emotion and cognition interact bidirectionally, so regulating negative affect may equally support deep strategy use or produce superficial compliance.
description-chinese: 学习情境中产生的好奇、挫折或焦虑等情绪，影响注意与策略使用并进而影响成绩。

name: 学习投入
label: education
description: The behavioural, emotional and cognitive effort a learner directs towards a learning activity, distinguished into behavioural, emotional and cognitive components. Observation protocols, experience sampling and trace-derived behavioural proxies are the usual measurement channels, each privileging a different component of engagement.
description-chinese: 学习者在学习活动中投入的行为、情感与认知努力，可分解为行为、情感与认知成分。

name: 学习机制
label: education
description: The account of which psychological operations cause a durable change in knowledge or skill, used to predict when an intervention will generalize and to explain why superficially similar activities produce different outcomes.
description-chinese: 解释何种心理操作导致知识或技能持久改变、可预测干预效果的原理。

name: 学习状态追踪
label: education
description: The continuous estimation and recording of a learner's evolving state over a course, combining interaction records, assessment results, and self-reports to support timely intervention rather than end-of-term reporting.
description-chinese: 融合交互记录、测评与自陈以支持及时干预的连续状态估计。

name: 学习环境
label: education
description: 学习者从事学习活动时所处物质、情感与社会关系的总和，包括物理布置、资源工具与同伴互动；现代研究将其区分为物理、虚拟与认知三个层面分别设计。
description-chinese: 学习者从事学习活动时所处物质、情感与社会关系的总和，含物理布置、资源工具与同伴互动。

name: 学习目标
label: education
description: The intended observable outcome of an instructional activity, stated at a level of specificity that allows both the activity design and the assessment to be aligned to it. Measurable verbs such as compare, justify, construct and critique reveal whether a stated target is genuinely attainable or merely aspirational.
description-chinese: 教学活动预期达成的可观测结果，须具体到足以使活动设计与评价与之对齐。

name: 学习科学
label: education
description: An interdisciplinary field drawing on cognitive psychology, neuroscience, and education research to characterize how durable learning arises and to translate that characterization into design principles for instruction.
description-chinese: 结合认知心理学与教育研究、阐明学习如何发生并转化为教学设计原则的跨学科领域。

name: 学习者先生成
label: education
description: A task design principle in which the learner commits to an answer or explanation before consulting an AI system, so that subsequent comparison is informative. The subsequent comparison makes disagreement informative and diagnostic, rather than merely absorbing the model's answer as an authoritative replacement.
description-chinese: 要求学习者在参考AI之前先独立给出答案或解释、使后续比对具有信息量的任务设计原则。

name: 学习观
label: education
description: 关于知识如何习得、学习者角色与学习结果来源的信念体系，涵盖知识建构主义与信息加工取向，其差异直接映射为不同的课堂话语与评价方式。
description-chinese: 关于知识如何习得、学习者角色与结果来源的信念体系，差异直接映射为不同的课堂话语与评价方式。

name: 学习风格
label: education
description: A learner's characteristic preferred approach to processing information, long proposed as a basis for matching instruction, though its instructional matching effect remains empirically contested. Learner-preference matching remains attractive to teachers on intuitive grounds despite weak empirical support, which complicates its professional disuse.
description-chinese: 学习者处理信息的偏好方式，曾被主张用于匹配教学，但其教学匹配效应的实证证据仍有争议。

name: 学术性阅读
label: education
description: 以论证结构、证据强度与方法透明度为评价标准的阅读方式，要求读者判断结论是否由所给证据支持，是从说明性文本向专业性文本过渡的关键能力。
description-chinese: 以论证结构、证据强度与方法透明度为评价标准的阅读方式，要求判断结论是否由证据支持。

name: 学校专属教育大模型
label: education
description: A language model adapted to one school's curriculum, policies and local institutional knowledge so that generated content reliably conforms to school-specific constraints, terminology and pedagogical conventions. Local adaptation improves institutional fit, though it narrows generalizability and concentrates risk in a single school-specific dependency.
description-chinese: 针对某校课程、政策与本地知识适配的语言模型，使生成内容符合本校规范与术语体系。

name: 学校数字基建
label: education
description: The hardware, network and platform infrastructure deployed at school level to support teaching, management and service delivery, treated as the physical precondition of institutional digitalization. Infrastructure decisions outlive the technology cycles that motivated them, making procurement choices a long-horizon institutional commitment.
description-chinese: 学校层面为支撑教学、管理与服务所部署的硬件、网络与平台基础设施，是校园数字化的物理前提。

name: 学校画像
label: education
description: A multi-dimensional data profile of a school covering achievement, resource endowment, teacher structure and equity, used to diagnose institutional conditions for support. School-level diagnostics are most actionable when disaggregated by grade, cohort and classroom, since aggregate figures routinely conceal the institutions where targeted support would actually help.
description-chinese: 涵盖学业、资源配置、师资结构与公平的多维学校数据画像，用于诊断受支持所需的校情。

name: 学生数字素养
label: education
description: The student's capacity to navigate digital environments, manage and verify information found online, create content responsibly, and recognise manipulative or machine-generated material encountered during study.
description-chinese: 学生驾驭数字环境、管理信息并识别操纵性或机器生成内容的能力。

name: 学生画像
label: education
description: An aggregated representation of a learner's knowledge states, interests, habits and recurring difficulties, constructed for differentiated instruction and support rather than for ranking or selection. Such representations become ethically sensitive precisely because they are persistent, granular and likely to shape opportunity allocation.
description-chinese: 为学习者知识状态、兴趣、习惯与困难所聚合的表征，用于差异化教学而非排名。

name: 学生综合发展评价报告
name_cn: 学生综合发展评价报告
label: education
description: A multidimensional report describing a learner's development across academic, physical, artistic and social dimensions with qualitative commentary rather than composite ranking. Such reports are most defensible when combining quantified indicators with qualitative commentary, since either alone distorts the picture.
description-chinese: 以质性评语而非综合排名，描述学习者在学业、身体、艺术与社会等多维发展情况的报告。

name: 学生表征
label: education
description: The system-level model of what a student knows, how they learn, and what they will likely do next, maintained from evidence and used to decide what support to offer rather than only to report progress.
description-chinese: 关于学生知识状态、学习方式与下一步行为的系统级模型。

name: 学生评价
label: education
description: The systematic collection and interpretation of evidence about student learning for the purposes of feedback, instructional decision making and accountability, rather than for ranking and selection alone. Validity constraints apply: evidence must support the inferences actually drawn from it before the resulting judgement can be used defensibly.
description-chinese: 为反馈、决策与问责而系统采集并解读学生学习证据，而非仅以排名为目的。

name: 学科教学
label: education
description: Teaching organized around the disciplinary knowledge, methods and representational practices of a school subject, distinct from interdisciplinary or theme-based organization. Discipline-based organization is what preserves specialized methods and representational practices that cross-disciplinary curricula later presuppose.
description-chinese: 围绕某学校学科的知识、方法与表征实践组织的教学，区别于跨学科或主题式组织。

name: 定性评估
label: education
description: 以叙述、案例与主题分析等非数值证据刻画学习过程与意义的评价取向，能够捕捉标准化测验无法呈现的过程性理解，其可靠性依赖编码程序的一致性。
description-chinese: 以叙述、案例与主题分析等非数值证据刻画学习过程与意义的取向，可靠性依赖编码程序一致性。

name: 实证校准
label: education
description: The procedure of adjusting model parameters or predicted scores so that their distribution matches observed outcome data, treating calibration as a separate requirement from rank-order accuracy.
description-chinese: 使模型参数或预测分数分布与观测结果一致的调整过程。

name: 实践关系
label: education
description: One of the constitutive relations of educational activity, in which the subject transforms both the object of study and itself through purposeful practice, making this relation the ground of knowledge rather than its application.
description-chinese: 教育活动中主体通过有目的的实践改造对象与自身、作为知识根基的关系。

name: 实践活动
label: education
description: Activity in which a subject transforms an external object according to a purpose, thereby displaying knowledge as skill and revealing the practical dimension of cognition.
description-chinese: 主体按目的改造外部对象的活动，体现知识作为技能的实践维度。

name: 家校共育
label: education
description: The normative ideal that families and schools share developmental aims and take reciprocal responsibility, rather than delegating education entirely to one party. Achieving this in practice requires institutional mechanisms and teacher preparation, not merely the articulation of shared values.
description-chinese: 家庭与学校共享发展目标并承担对等责任的教育理念，而非将教育完全委托于其中一方。

name: 家校协同
label: education
description: Structured cooperation between families and schools in which goals, information flows and forms of support for learners are jointly coordinated rather than unilaterally decided at school. Asymmetries of expertise and authority mean that nominal collaboration can mask unilateral decision-making unless participation is genuinely reciprocal.
description-chinese: 家庭与学校的结构化合作，共同协调学习者的目标、信息与支持，而非由学校单方决定。

name: 家校教育
label: education
description: The combined educational influence exerted on a learner by family and school, analysed with attention to consistency or conflict between their goals, methods and expectations. Congruence between home and school expectations plausibly matters more for learner outcomes than the absolute level of either.
description-chinese: 家庭与学校对学习者施加的联合教育影响，需关注二者目标、方法与期望之间的一致或冲突。

name: 家校数据看板
label: education
description: A dashboard exposing a carefully summarized view of learner progress to parents, designed to support home-school communication while constraining surveillance and prejudicial labelling effects. Transparency of this kind can itself become a source of pressure when families interpret dashboard metrics as fixed judgements about their children.
description-chinese: 向家长呈现学习进步摘要的看板，用于支撑家校沟通，同时限制监控与标签化效应。

name: 对话式导学
label: education
description: Scaffolding delivered through sustained dialogue in which the tutor probes reasoning, elicits counter-examples and guides the learner to articulate and revise their understanding. Turn structure typically alternates among open questions, targeted probes, graduated hints and explicit scaffolding moves, distributed across the dialogue.
description-chinese: 通过持续对话实施的支持策略，导师追问推理、引导举例并促使学习者表述与修正理解。

name: 对话式测量
label: education
description: Assessment conducted through an interactive exchange in which follow-up questions are chosen based on prior responses, eliciting reasoning that fixed items cannot reach. Scores must be calibrated across parallel dialogues so that verbosity and fluency are not systematically rewarded as though they were evidence.
description-chinese: 通过互动问答开展的评价，依先前回答动态选择追问以引出固定题目无法触及的推理。

name: 对象性化活动
label: education
description: Activity whose objects and goals are fixed externally by institutions or others, so that the subject participates in but does not originate the purposes governing the act.
description-chinese: 对象与目的由制度或他者外在规定、主体只参与而不发起目的的活动。

name: 小学育人场景重构
label: education
description: The reorganization of primary school educational scenes so that physical, digital and social contexts jointly support developmental goals rather than functioning merely as channels for delivering predetermined content. Reorganizing scenes changes what counts as evidence of learning, so scene design and assessment design are necessarily coupled decisions.
description-chinese: 重组小学教育场景，使物理、数字与社会情境共同服务于发展目标，而非仅止于内容传递。

name: 差异化
label: education
description: The intentional variation of task content, difficulty, support, or pacing in response to assessed differences in learner readiness, contrasted with differentiation that merely assigns identical work at different levels.
description-chinese: 依据学习者准备度差异调整任务内容、难度、支架与节奏的差异化安排。

name: 师徒同课异构
label: education
description: A professional development format in which a mentor and a novice teach the same content differently and then compare designs, exposing the tacit decisions of expert practice. The comparison exposes decision points of expert practice that neither participant could articulate independently beforehand.
description-chinese: 师徒以同一内容进行差异化教学后比较设计的教研形式，揭示专家教学中的隐性决策。

name: 师生脑耦合
label: education
description: The temporal synchronisation of neural activity between teacher and learner during instruction, taken as an index of shared attention and communicative alignment. Studies typically record electroencephalography or functional near-infrared spectroscopy from both partners during dyadic tasks, and interpret the coupling as shared attention.
description-chinese: 教学过程中教师与学习者神经活动的时间同步，被视为共享注意与交流一致的指标。

name: 康复技术
label: education
description: Interventions and technologies intended to restore or compensate for function lost through injury, illness, or developmental difference, evaluated with particular attention to generalization into everyday settings.
description-chinese: 旨在恢复或代偿因损伤或发育差异而丧失的功能的干预与技术。

name: 循证教研
label: education
description: Instructional research in which a specific pedagogical problem is diagnosed, an intervention is designed from available evidence, and its effect is rigorously evaluated before adoption. Adopting interventions without local validation remains a risk, since effect sizes established elsewhere may not transfer to a different population and setting.
description-chinese: 先诊断具体教学问题、据现有证据设计干预并严格评估效果，方予推广的教研方式。

name: 心理健康
label: education
description: A state of mental functioning permitting the individual to cope with normal stresses, realize abilities and contribute to community life, not merely the absence of disorder. Promotional framing shifts the focus from treating disorder towards creating conditions in which individuals can flourish.
description-chinese: 个体能够应对常态压力、实现自身能力并参与社区生活的心理功能状态，而非仅指无障碍。

name: 心理活动
label: education
description: The internal processes of sensation, perception, memory, thinking, and feeling taken together as the object of psychology, distinguished from behaviour from which it is only indirectly inferred.
description-chinese: 感觉知觉记忆思维情感等内部过程的总称，心理学的研究对象。

name: 思维外显
label: education
description: 将个体不可见的思考过程以语言、图示或操作等形式表达出来使其可被观察与评价的做法，其实现依赖教学为内隐推理预留显性化的表达通道。
description-chinese: 将不可见的思考过程以语言、图示或操作表达出来使之可被观察与评价，需教学为内隐推理预留显性通道。

name: 患病负担
label: education
description: A summary of how much a condition reduces population health, usually combining prevalence, disability weight, and duration, used to justify allocation of detection and support resources.
description-chinese: 结合患病率、失能权重与病程衡量某疾病对人群健康影响的指标。

name: 情境化
label: education
description: The adaptation of content or activity to the learner's concrete situation, prior knowledge and cultural setting so that abstract material acquires situational meaning. Contextualized materials improve apparent relevance, though excessive contextualization risks reducing transfer to genuinely novel situations.
description-chinese: 将内容或活动适配于学习者的具体情境、先备知识与文化背景，使抽象材料获得情境意义。

name: 情感活动
label: education
description: The affective dimension of mental life involving valuation, arousal, and attachment, treated as a distinct system from cognition because it can be disrupted while cognition is largely preserved.
description-chinese: 涉及评价、唤醒与依恋的情感维度，可与认知相对独立受损。

name: 情感状态
label: education
description: The learner's transient affective configuration, including valence and arousal, as inferred from physiological or behavioural evidence and treated as relevant to engagement. Continuous affect detection remains difficult because affect is expressed differently across individuals and contexts, and because expression decays rapidly after onset.
description-chinese: 由生理或行为证据推断的学习者瞬时情感构型，涵盖效价与唤醒度并与学习投入相关。

name: 情绪监测
label: education
description: Continuous or periodic inference of learners' affective states from behavioural and physiological signals, deployed to trigger timely support and regulation rather than to evaluate or label them. Inferred affective states are inherently uncertain, so inferences should trigger offers of support rather than recorded judgements about a learner's character.
description-chinese: 由行为与生理信号持续或定期推断学习者情感状态，用以触发及时支持而非对其作出评价。

name: 意志活动
label: education
description: Goal-directed mental activity that regulates behaviour by engaging effort, delaying gratification, and overriding competing impulses in pursuit of a chosen end against competing temptations.
description-chinese: 为达成目的而调节行为、付出努力并克制冲动的心智活动。

name: 感知测量
label: education
description: The operationalization of a perceptual judgement as a numeric quantity derived from behavioural responses or signals, requiring that stimulus and response be standardized for values to be comparable.
description-chinese: 把知觉判断操作化为可量化的行为或信号指标以供比较。

name: 成长档案
label: education
description: A longitudinal record of a learner's work, reflections and progress assembled over time to support self-assessment, formative feedback and personalized instructional decision making. Portfolios become educationally valuable only when reflection is required, since unreviewed accumulation of work yields little interpretive learning.
description-chinese: 跨时间汇集学习者作品、反思与进步所成的纵向记录，用以支持自评、反馈与个性化教学决策。

name: 执行功能
label: education
description: Cognitive control processes comprising inhibitory control, working memory updating and cognitive flexibility that regulate goal-directed behaviour in the face of competing demands. Its components show only partial separability in performance, so most laboratory tasks load more than one control process at once.
description-chinese: 由抑制控制、工作记忆更新与认知灵活性构成、用于调节目标导向行为的认知控制过程。

name: 批判性思考
label: education
description: 对主张所依赖的证据、假设与推理结构作审慎评估并形成独立判断的能力，其培养依赖认知冲突情境与论证性对话，而非知识量的简单累积。
description-chinese: 对主张的证据、假设与推理结构作审慎评估并形成独立判断的能力，培养依赖认知冲突与论证性对话。

name: 抽象思维
label: education
description: Thinking that operates on relations and general properties with imagery and specific context stripped away, which is what makes systematic law-finding and deductive argument possible.
description-chinese: 剥离具体形象与情境、在关系与一般属性上运算的思维。

name: 探究能力
label: education
description: The ability to pose answerable questions, design procedures, collect and interpret evidence, and revise conclusions in the face of contrary findings. Developing this capacity requires tolerating unresolved inquiry, which sits in tension with the demand for clear answers that characterizes conventional schooling.
description-chinese: 提出可回答的问题、设计程序、收集与解释证据，并在遇到相反证据时修正结论的能力。

name: 教-学协同
label: education
description: The reciprocal alignment in which teaching decisions are informed by evidence about what learners actually do, and learning activities are designed to make the intended teaching moves effective.
description-chinese: 教学决策依据学习者实际表现调整、学习活动设计以配合教学意图。

name: 教学工具
label: education
description: Instruments and media through which content is represented and practised, selected according to how their affordances interact with the learning objective at hand. Affordances shape the activity they serve, so a tool is never neutral with respect to which learning behaviours it makes convenient.
description-chinese: 用以表征与练习内容的器具与媒介，须依其可供性如何与当下学习目标互动来选择。

name: 教学模式固化
label: education
description: The rigid stabilization of a single instructional pattern within a school, which suppresses adaptation to learner differences and progressively blocks pedagogical renewal and curricular reform. Institutional inertia typically preserves the established pattern because departing from it exposes practitioners to evaluative risk.
description-chinese: 学校内部某种单一教学模式的僵化稳定，压抑对学习者差异的适应并阻碍教学更新。

name: 教学评一致性
label: education
description: 教学目标、课堂活动与评价任务在所考查的构念与认知层次上彼此对齐的设计原则，不一致时学生将学到应试策略而非目标能力。
description-chinese: 教学目标、课堂活动与评价任务在所考查构念与认知层次上对齐的设计原则，不一致则导向应试策略。

name: 教师二次创作
label: education
description: Teacher-led reworking of AI-generated materials into classroom-ready form through selection, restructuring, contextualization to learner characteristics and the addition of professional pedagogical judgement. The value added in this stage is precisely what automated generation cannot supply, namely responsiveness to particular learners and institutional constraints.
description-chinese: 教师以选择、重组、情境化并注入专业判断的方式，将AI生成素材二次加工为可用课堂材料。

name: 教师参与的课堂设计
label: education
description: Classroom design practice in which teachers retain authorship over goals, task selection, and interpretation of technology output, with system behaviour constrained to roles teachers have explicitly accepted.
