description-chinese: 教师保有目标设定与结果解释权、系统角色由教师认可的教学设计实践。

name: 教师教育大模型
label: education
description: A domain-adapted language model supporting teacher education through lesson simulation, classroom case analysis and mentoring dialogue grounded in pedagogical knowledge. Simulated classrooms are most valuable where they expose consequential decision points to deliberation rather than merely supplying model answer content.
description-chinese: 以教育学知识为基础、通过教学模拟、课堂案例分析与指导对话支撑教师教育的领域适配大模型。

name: 教师数字素养
label: education
description: The teacher's competence in using, evaluating, and critically adapting digital tools for instructional purposes, including the judgement to decline or restrict them when they would undermine learning.
description-chinese: 教师在教学中使用、评价并批判性改造数字工具的胜任力。

name: 教师画像
label: education
description: A data representation of a teacher's instructional practice, workload distribution and professional development needs, used to target training provision and to reduce avoidable administrative burden. Used carelessly, such profiles function as unacknowledged performance surveillance, undermining the trust necessary for professional disclosure.
description-chinese: 对教师教学实践、工作负荷与专业发展需求的数据表征，用于精准培训并减轻行政负担。

name: 教师素养
label: education
description: 教师履行教学职责所需的知识、技能、态度与专业伦理的综合结构，涵盖学科教学知识、教育知识与技术素养，其测量需区分自陈问卷与基于课堂观察的行为指标。
description-chinese: 教师履行教学职责所需的知识、技能、态度与伦理的综合结构，涵盖学科与教育知识及技术素养。

name: 教师角色
label: education
description: The expected set of functions and behaviours attaching to the teacher role, shifting as knowledge availability changes from scarce to abundant and as assessment moves toward verification.
description-chinese: 随着知识可得性增加与评价转向核验而变化的教师职能期望集合。

name: 教育实验
label: education
description: A controlled intervention in which an educational treatment is manipulated and its effect on learning outcomes measured, ideally with random assignment and pretesting. Recurring threats include differential attrition, contamination between treatment and control, and realised effect sizes far smaller than those powering the design.
description-chinese: 操控某种教育干预并测量其对学习结果影响的受控实验，通常包含随机分配与前测。

name: 教育生态
label: education
description: The interdependent network of schools, families, communities, platforms and regulators whose mutual relations shape educational outcomes more than any single actor. Interdependence means that the behavior of any single actor is substantially conditioned by the incentives and capacity of all the others.
description-chinese: 由学校、家庭、社区、平台与监管者构成的相互依赖网络，其关系较之任何单一主体更能决定教育成效。

name: 教育科研
label: education
description: Systematic inquiry into educational practice employing theory, design and evidence to produce knowledge that can inform instructional decision-making. The distinguishing requirement is that conclusions must be warranted by evidence and specific enough to guide the decisions they claim to inform.
description-chinese: 运用理论设计与证据对教育实践进行系统探究，以产出可指导教学决策的知识。

name: 教育科研诚信审查
label: education
description: Institutional review of data provenance, authorship, and disclosure practice in educational research, extended to cover the use of generative tools and the traceability of reported findings.
description-chinese: 对教育科研的数据来源、署名与生成式工具使用进行诚信审查。

name: 数字化
label: education
description: The conversion of educational objects, processes and records into data representations, making teaching activities computable, storable, comparable and analyzable at scale across learners and contexts. Digital representation also makes processes comparable and governable in ways that precede their pedagogical desirability.
description-chinese: 将教育对象、过程与记录转换为数据表征，使教学活动可计算、可存储并可规模化分析。

name: 数字白板
label: education
description: 支持手写输入、资源调用与过程回放的交互式电子显示设备，其教学增益须与操作认知负荷同时评估，否则工具熟练度会掩盖学习效果的实际缺失。
description-chinese: 支持手写输入、资源调用与过程回放的交互式电子显示设备，增益须与操作认知负荷同时评估。

name: 数字素养
label: education
description: The umbrella competence comprising information, communication, content-creation, safety, and problem-solving aspects of living and learning with digital technologies, assessed as context-dependent rather than fixed.
description-chinese: 涵盖信息、通信、内容创作、安全与问题解决等维度的综合素养。

name: 数字胜任力
label: education
description: The combined capability to use digital tools critically and responsibly, manage information, collaborate and create, encompassing both technical and ethical competence. Frameworks differ in whether they subsume data literacy, media literacy, and civic or ethical dimensions, which materially changes what instruction must target.
description-chinese: 批判且负责任地使用数字工具、管理信息、协作与创造的综合能力，兼具技术与伦理素养。

name: 数学主义
label: education
description: The position that the systematic and precisely stated, whether mathematical or formalized, constitute the proper content of knowledge, contrasted with emphasis on historical practice and contextual meaning.
description-chinese: 主张系统且精确表述构成知识内容的立场。

name: 数据赋分
label: education
description: The automatic computation of continuous formative scores from behavioural and performance data, used to drive immediate adaptive scaffolding and targeted support within the flow of instruction. Continuous computed scores require validation against meaningful learning outcomes before they are permitted to carry high stakes.
description-chinese: 由行为与表现数据自动计算形成性连续分数，用以在教学过程中驱动即时自适应支持。

name: 数智化
label: education
description: The stage beyond digitization in which data intelligence together with digital technology drives decision making, adaptive service delivery and human-machine collaborative governance of institutions. At this stage the critical question becomes whether intelligence is deployed to serve institutional aims or to reshape them.
description-chinese: 数字化之后的阶段，数据智能与数字技术共同驱动决策、自适应服务与人机协同治理。

name: 数智化转型
label: education
description: The process by which an educational organization integrates digital technology with data intelligence in order to restructure its governance, instructional and research processes rather than merely digitizing them. Transformation of this kind typically fails where organizational structures are left unchanged, since technology alone redistributes rather than improves effort.
description-chinese: 教育组织将数字技术与数据智能相融合以重构其治理、教学与研究过程的过程。

name: 数智场域
label: education
description: The educational field reconstituted by the coupling of digital technology with data-driven decision mechanisms, in which educational actors act upon data and are simultaneously acted upon by it. The constitutive role of data means that what is not captured remains outside the field's capacity to be governed or improved.
description-chinese: 数字技术与数据驱动决策机制耦合后重构的教育场域，其中教育行动者作用于数据亦为数据所作用。

name: 数智导师
label: education
description: An AI tutoring role combining conversational guidance with learner modelling and progress tracking, positioned as a continuous supplement to teacher instruction. Effective deployment requires calibrated intervention, since premature assistance undermines exactly the productive struggle such systems ought to sustain.
description-chinese: 结合对话式引导、学习者建模与进度追踪的AI辅导角色，定位为教师教学的持续补充。

name: 数智时代知识转型
label: education
description: The reorganization of what counts as knowledge and how it is legitimized under digital and intelligent technologies, including the shift from fixed content toward process and judgement.
description-chinese: 数智技术下知识形态与合法性来源的重组。

name: 数智治理
label: education
description: The application of data and artificial intelligence to institutional decision-making, coordinating, evaluating and enforcing rules across distributed educational units. Governance via data can make decisions more consistent and more legible while simultaneously making them harder to contest.
description-chinese: 将数据与人工智能应用于机构决策，在分布式的教育单元间协调、评估与执行规则。

name: 数智育人
label: education
description: Educational practice in which digital and data intelligence support developmental goals, shifting the teacher's role toward guidance, diagnosis and emotional accompaniment. The pedagogical question is what should remain irreducibly human in teaching, since that boundary determines the appropriate division of labour.
description-chinese: 以数字与数据智能支持发展目标的教育实践，使教师角色转向引导、诊断与情感陪伴。

name: 整本书阅读
label: education
description: 以一本书的完整文本为学习对象、在数周至一学期内持续推进的阅读教学形态，强调对整体结构的把握与反复深读，而非将文本切分为片段用于技巧训练。
description-chinese: 以一本书的完整文本为对象、持续数周推进的阅读教学形态，强调把握整体结构与反复深读而非片段技巧训练。

name: 文化基因
label: education
description: The analogy or structure treated as the minimal transmitted unit of a culture, carried across generations through imitation, ritual, and instruction rather than through biological heredity.
description-chinese: 作为文化最小传承单位、通过模仿与教化而非基因传递的结构。

name: 文化理解
label: education
description: Accurate grasp of the meanings, norms, and assumptions of another culture as understood by its members, achieved by suspending one's own categories rather than by projecting them.
description-chinese: 悬置自身范畴、把握他文化成员所理解的规范与假设。

name: 文化认同
label: education
description: A person's sense of belonging to and internalization of a cultural group, formed through participation and reflection and implicated in both motivation and identity-related achievement outcomes.
description-chinese: 个体对所属文化群体的归属感与内在接纳，与动机及成就相关。

name: 显著性差异
label: education
description: A statistical conclusion that the probability of observing a difference this large under a null hypothesis of no effect falls below a preset threshold, reported together with the effect size.
description-chinese: 在零假设下次出现的差异概率低于预设阈值的统计结论。

name: 智慧作业
label: education
description: Homework delivery in which diagnostics, adaptive sequencing and automated feedback operate at the level of individual exercises within the assignment as a whole. The pedagogical significance depends entirely on whether responses are acted upon, since unprocessed automated feedback is inert information.
description-chinese: 在作业的每一道题目层面实施诊断、自适应编排与自动反馈的作业交付方式。

name: 智慧职教
label: education
description: Digital transformation of vocational education in which simulated and enterprise data support skill training, placement and continuous updating of occupational standards. Because occupational standards change rapidly with technology, curricular updating must be continuous rather than periodic to remain credible.
description-chinese: 职业教育的数字化转型，以仿真与企业数据支持技能训练、就业对接与职业标准持续更新。

name: 智慧评价系统
label: education
description: A system collecting multidimensional behavioural evidence through learning analytics and converting it into diagnostic feedback and formative evaluation rather than into a single aggregated score. Diagnostic interpretation requires validated instruments, otherwise rich data collection merely produces confident and unfounded judgements.
description-chinese: 通过学习分析采集多维行为证据并转化为诊断性反馈与形成性评价，而非单一分数的系统。

name: 智慧课堂
label: education
description: 以网络化教学终端、数据采集与即时互动支持为特征的教学环境形态，其教学价值取决于互动数据是否被转化为反馈动作而非仅被记录。
description-chinese: 以网络化终端、数据采集与即时互动为特征的教学环境，价值取决于互动数据是否转化为反馈动作。

name: 智能备课
label: education
description: 借助模型辅助教师完成目标设定、学情分析与教学流程与资源准备的实践形式，其评价标准应是备课产物的可用性与教师判断的不可替代性是否被保留。
description-chinese: 借助模型辅助教师完成目标设定、学情分析与资源准备的实践，评价标准是产物可用性与教师判断的不可替代性。

name: 智能学伴
label: education
description: 面向单个学习者持续提供答疑、练习与进度支持的对话式学习系统，其关键设计约束是不过度代劳，须保留学生的独立求解过程与求助时机。
description-chinese: 面向单个学习者持续提供答疑、练习与进度支持的对话式系统，设计约束是不过度代劳并保留独立求解过程。

name: 智能导师
label: education
description: A software system that acts as an automated tutor by tracking learner state, selecting instructional actions and delivering feedback in response to a learner's requests. Evaluation typically compares system-supported tutoring against classroom instruction on learning gains, while also accounting for the substantial interaction cost.
description-chinese: 追踪学习状态、选择教学动作并对学习者请求作出反馈的自动化教学软件系统。

name: 智能微课生成
label: education
description: Automated production of short, tightly focused instructional videos from script, storyboard, narration and asset generation, supporting the rapid creation of small-granularity digital learning resources. Short formats suit concept-level objectives but compress the opportunities for sustained guided practice that harder learning requires.
description-chinese: 由脚本、分镜与解说自动生成短小聚焦的教学视频，支撑小粒度学习资源的快速制作。

name: 智能教育
label: education
description: An educational paradigm in which data, algorithms and intelligent agents are embedded in instruction to adapt content sequencing, pacing and feedback to individual learners. Datafication risks arise whenever engagement proxies are mistaken for measures of learning itself, or when optimisation targets displace the pedagogical intent.
description-chinese: 把数据、算法与智能体嵌入教学以按个体学习者调整内容序列、节奏与反馈的教育范式。

name: 智能析课
label: education
description: 利用语音转写与多模态分析对课堂实录进行自动分析的方法，可量化教师话语占比、提问分布与学生参与时长，其指标须经人工编码校准后方可解释。
description-chinese: 利用语音转写与多模态分析自动解析课堂实录的方法，可量化话语占比与提问分布，指标须经人工编码校准。

name: 智能测评
label: education
description: 由系统自动组卷、评分并生成诊断报告的测评实践，其效度依赖于题目与教学目标的一致性，若构念与目标错配则自动化只会放大原有的测量偏差。
description-chinese: 由系统自动组卷、评分并生成诊断报告的测评实践，效度取决于题目与教学目标的一致性。

name: 智能评价
label: education
description: Assessment in which AI performs scoring, rubric alignment or diagnostic inference to shorten feedback latency, subject to explicit validity, transparency and fairness requirements. Fully automated scoring remains vulnerable to construct-irrelevant variance, whereby irrelevant features drive scores rather than the intended competence.
description-chinese: 由AI执行评分、量规对齐或诊断推断以缩短反馈时延的评价，须满足效度与透明度要求。

name: 智能评课
label: education
description: 借助自动语音识别与多模态模型对课堂录像生成教学行为指标与改进建议的方式，其有效性以与人工观察的一致性及建议的可执行性为前提。
description-chinese: 借助自动语音识别与多模态模型生成课堂行为指标与改进建议，有效性以人工观察一致性与建议可执行性为前提。

name: 最近发展区
label: education
description: The distance between the level a learner can achieve unaided and the level reachable with skilled guidance, defining the range within which instruction is most effective. Dynamic assessment operationalises the zone by estimating current unaided performance and guided performance in parallel and comparing the two.
description-chinese: 学习者独立所能达到的水平与在熟练引导下所能达到水平之间的差距，即教学最有效的区间。

name: 机制假设
label: education
description: An explicit and falsifiable claim about the causal chain connecting an educational design choice to a learning outcome, stated so that it can be supported or contradicted by designed observations.
description-chinese: 关于教育设计选择如何导致学习结果的可证伪因果链陈述。

name: 机制检验
label: education
description: The empirical attempt to establish that an intervention works through a proposed causal pathway, tested by manipulating or measuring the mediator and checking that the effect on outcomes is correspondingly attenuated.
description-chinese: 通过操纵或测量中介变量、检验效应是否相应减弱来验证因果通路。

name: 条件反射
label: education
description: The learned association through which a previously neutral stimulus comes to elicit a response, established by repeated pairing with an unconditioned stimulus and subject to extinction and generalization.
description-chinese: 中性刺激经反复与无条件刺激配对后获得引发反应能力的习得联结。

name: 板书
label: education
description: 教师在黑板或白板上随教学进程生成的书面表征，起到固化推理过程、暴露结构与承担外部记忆载体的作用，研究中常按内容质量与时机加以编码。
description-chinese: 教师在黑板或白板上随教学进程生成的书面表征，固化推理过程、暴露结构并承担外部记忆载体功能。

name: 校本智库
label: education
description: A school-level knowledge repository and expert community that accumulates and retrieves locally validated solutions to recurring institutional problems. Institutional memory of this kind depends on deliberate documentation, otherwise it resides tacitly in departing staff and is lost.
description-chinese: 校本级的知识库与专家共同体，积累并检索针对常见校务问题的本地化有效解决方案。

name: 校本资源库
label: education
description: A school-level repository of teaching materials accumulated from teachers' own practice, encoding local curricular interpretation and the institution's accumulated pedagogical expertise. Such a repository also constitutes an institutional memory, preserving curriculum decisions that would otherwise be lost as staff turnover occurs.
description-chinese: 由教师自身实践素材积累而成的校级素材库，承载本校课程理解与组织性的课程经验。

name: 核心素养
label: education
description: 个体在复杂情境中综合运用知识、观念、方法与品格解决真实问题的关键能力，强调跨情境迁移与整合，其课程落实需以表现性任务而非学科知识点加以测评。
description-chinese: 个体在复杂情境中综合运用知识、观念、方法与品格解决真实问题的关键能力，强调跨情境迁移整合。

name: 概念判断
label: education
description: The act of deciding whether an instance falls under a category and, where it does not, whether the category should be revised, treated as the fundamental epistemic operation from which classification follows.
description-chinese: 判定个例是否属于某范畴、或是否应修订范畴的基本认知操作。

name: 母语能力
label: education
description: The learner's total capacity in their first language, integrating vocabulary, grammar, discourse competence, cultural knowledge and pragmatic appropriateness into a unified communicative resource. Because transfer from first language proficiency to additional languages is substantial, mother tongue capacity is foundational rather than merely supplementary.
description-chinese: 学习者在第一语言上的整体能力，整合词汇、语法、语篇、文化知识与交际能力而成的统一资源。

name: 注意力
label: education
description: The selective allocation of limited cognitive processing resources to relevant stimuli or tasks, subject to involuntary capture, sustained and executive control. Attention is finite and strategic, so instructional design must budget it explicitly rather than treating it as an unlimited resource.
description-chinese: 将有限认知加工资源选择性分配予相关刺激或任务，受无意捕获、持续性调节与执行控制支配。

name: 深度融合
label: education
description: Integration in which technology alters the pedagogy and assessment practices themselves rather than being added to existing lessons, so that the instructional process is changed rather than merely instrumented.
description-chinese: 技术改变教学与评价实践本身、而非仅附着于既有课堂的融合。

name: 深度阅读
label: education
description: 读者对文本作多层推理、证据核查与观点评价的阅读方式，其识别指标包括是否援引文本证据、是否区分事实与主张以及是否生成可修正的解读。
description-chinese: 读者对文本作多层推理、证据核查与观点评价的阅读方式，识别指标包括援引证据与区分事实与主张。

name: 演绎推理
label: education
description: Inference whose conclusion follows necessarily from premises by virtue of logical form alone, so that the premises being true guarantee the conclusion without supplying new content.
description-chinese: 结论仅凭逻辑形式即必然从前提推出的推理，前提为真则结论必真。

name: 状态演化
label: education
description: The trajectory through which an individual's knowledge state, attention, or strategy profile changes over a sequence of interactions, estimated from longitudinal records rather than from a single snapshot.
description-chinese: 个体知识状态或策略剖面随交互序列变化的轨迹。

name: 现代教育技术
label: education
description: 以多媒体、网络与计算设备为支撑，优化教学过程的教育技术体系，其成效评估须超越设备使用率而考察是否改变了学习活动结构与认知负荷分布。
description-chinese: 以多媒体、网络与计算设备支撑以优化教学过程的技术体系，评估须超越设备使用率而考察活动结构与认知负荷。

name: 理论修正
label: education
description: The revision of an established theoretical account in light of evidence that its constructs are imprecise or its scope claims too strong, with attention to whether the change is local or foundational.
description-chinese: 依据证据修正既有理论、明确修正属于局部调整还是根本性改变。

name: 理论转译
label: education
description: The work of restating a finding or construct from one research tradition into the conceptual vocabulary of another so that it becomes usable in a different field without losing its original precision.
description-chinese: 把某一研究传统的发现或构念用另一领域的概念语言重新表述的过程。

name: 生成式心理测量
label: education
description: A measurement paradigm in which items are generated or adaptively selected in dialogue with the learner, so that the instrument responds to the individual being assessed. Comparability across administrations must be established explicitly, since items generated for one learner are not exchangeable with items generated for another.
description-chinese: 在测量中由系统在与学习者对话中生成或自适应选题、使工具随被测个体而变化的范式。

name: 病理机制
label: education
description: The chain of biological and cognitive processes proposed to produce a disorder, distinguished from the descriptive label because it determines which intervention targets would be rational.
description-chinese: 导致某障碍的生物与认知过程链条，决定干预靶点的合理性。

name: 真实探究任务
label: education
description: A task set in a problem situation resembling those practitioners actually face, requiring learners to apply knowledge to produce an artifact or decision under real constraints. Authenticity is constrained by curricular time, so fidelity to professional practice must be traded against feasibility within the school day.
description-chinese: 设置于类似从业者真实面临的问题情境中的任务，要求学习者在现实约束下运用知识产出成果或决策。

name: 知识产权归属
label: education
description: The determination of who owns work produced with AI assistance in teaching and research, covering authorship, licensing and the right to claim credit. Existing copyright and authorship frameworks were designed for individual human creation and fit such collaborative output poorly.
description-chinese: 确定教学与研究中借助AI完成的成果归谁所有，涵盖署名、许可与主张贡献的权利。

name: 知识体系
label: education
description: A set of propositions organized so that each is connected to others by derivation or evidence, providing internal coherence and distinguishing a field of knowledge from an accumulation of claims.
description-chinese: 命题之间以推导或证据相连、具备内在一致性的知识组织。

name: 知识分工
label: education
description: The social arrangement in which expertise is divided so that no individual possesses the whole of what a problem requires, making coordination and shared language integral to productive work.
description-chinese: 专业能力在社会中被分割、无人掌握问题全部所需知识的安排。

name: 知识哲学
label: education
description: The branch of philosophy examining what it is to know something and what distinguishes knowledge from true belief, asking which conditions must be satisfied by a justified true claim.
description-chinese: 考察何为知道某物、知识何以区别于真信念的哲学分支。

name: 知识建构
label: education
description: The process by which learners actively assemble and reorganise information into connected structures, so that meaning is generated rather than transmitted intact. Evidence is drawn from think-aloud protocols, concept mapping, and systematic analysis of classroom discourse about how learners reorganise information.
description-chinese: 学习者主动将信息组装并重组为连接结构、意义由生成而非完整传递的过程。

name: 知识生产
label: education
description: The social and institutional processes through which claims are made, peer-reviewed, published, and legitimated, including the roles of journals, universities, and funding bodies in conferring authority.
description-chinese: 主张经同行评议、发表与制度认证而获得合法性的社会过程。

name: 知识生态
label: education
description: The relations among knowledge producers, transmitters, and users within an environment, in which generation, circulation, evaluation, and application are interdependent rather than separable sequential stages.
description-chinese: 知识的生产者、传播者与使用者之间相互依存的关系环境。

name: 知识生成
label: education
description: 在教学过程中由学习者主动建构并验证新理解的过程，其产出并非既有信息的复制，而是经由经验整合与论证形成的可供检验的陈述。
description-chinese: 教学过程中学习者主动建构新理解的过程，其产出并非信息复制而是经经验整合与论证形成的可检验陈述。

name: 知识精细加工
label: education
description: The elaborative processing of material through explanation, comparison, integration and application, which deepens encoding and supports later retrieval and transfer. Elaboration is most commonly elicited through self-explanation prompts that ask why an example follows from a rule rather than restating the rule.
description-chinese: 通过解释、比较、整合与应用对材料作精细加工，以加深编码并支持日后提取与迁移。

name: 知识诊断
label: education
description: 由答题反应反推学习者对知识点的掌握概率与典型错误模式的推断技术，输出不仅是正确率，还包括错误项所反映的误解类型，直接决定下一步教学内容的选取。
description-chinese: 由答题反应反推知识点掌握概率与典型错误模式的推断技术，输出错误类型并决定后续教学内容选取。

name: 知识谱系
label: education
description: The lineage of concepts tracing how a current term inherits and revises earlier usages, used to reveal that apparently stable categories are the sediment of prior debates.
description-chinese: 追溯概念沿革以揭示当前范畴是既往争论积淀而成的谱系。

name: 知识迁移
label: education
description: The application of knowledge or procedures acquired in one context to a different context, whose occurrence depends on the learner's recognition of deep structural similarity. Transfer is therefore assessed with structurally dissimilar tasks, since high surface similarity inflates apparent transfer through shared cues rather than understanding.
description-chinese: 把某一情境中习得的知识或程序应用于另一情境，其发生依赖学习者对深层结构相似性的识别。

name: 知识重构
label: education
description: The transformation of an existing knowledge structure into a reorganised form following the assimilation of new experience, involving accommodation of prior schemas. The shift is evidenced indirectly, by changed recall of counterexamples and by altered sorting behaviour in classification tasks.
description-chinese: 新经验被同化后既有知识结构被改造为重组形态的过程，涉及原有图式的顺应。

name: 社交障碍
label: education
description: Persistent difficulty in reciprocal social interaction, including initiating, maintaining, and understanding exchanges, assessed across both verbal and non-verbal channels and distinguished from mere shyness.
description-chinese: 在言语与非言语通道上持续存在的社会互动困难。

name: 社会创新需求
label: education
description: The problems in industry, public services, and communities that generate the demand pulling curricular and institutional change, used to justify reform in terms of unmet societal need.
description-chinese: 来自产业、公共服务与社区的问题所构成的变革需求来源。

name: 社会性
label: education
description: The dimension of development concerned with orientation to others, reciprocity, and participation in social exchange, operationally indexed by gaze allocation, initiation counts, or response latency.
description-chinese: 关乎对他人定向、互惠与参与社会交往的发展维度。

name: 神经发育障碍
label: education
description: A diagnostic class covering conditions with early-onset deviations in cognition, language, or social functioning that persist into adulthood and therefore shape long-term educational access needs.
description-chinese: 涵盖认知、语言或社会功能早期偏离并持续影响教育需要的诊断类别。

name: 神经心理机制
label: education
description: The specification of which cognitive function is implemented by which neural system, inferred from converging imaging and behavioural evidence and used to explain why a deficit takes a particular form.
description-chinese: 由神经影像与行为证据共同推断的认知功能与神经系统对应关系。

name: 科学编史学
label: education
description: The historical study of how scientific ideas were generated, circulated, and credited, used to correct retrospective rational reconstructions of discovery with documented sequence and contingency.
description-chinese: 考察科学观念如何产生、流传与获得承认的研究领域。

name: 科学解释
label: education
description: A statement of the kind of entity or process that makes some observed regularity intelligible, judged not by whether it merely repeats the observation but by whether it supplies testable general claims.
description-chinese: 说明何种实体或过程使规律可理解的陈述，须提供可检验的一般性论断。

name: 组织底座
label: education
description: The governance, staffing and coordination arrangements that make technical platforms actually usable, determining whether shared digital assets are genuinely adopted in everyday practice. Absent such arrangements, shared platforms accumulate features used by few while critical integration needs remain unmet.
description-chinese: 使技术平台得以被使用的治理、人员与协同机制，决定共享数字资产能否真正落地应用。

name: 经验
label: education
description: Knowledge derived from immediate acquaintance with particular situations, distinguished from rational and systematic knowledge on the question whether it can be transmitted or only re-acquired.
description-chinese: 由个别情境的直接接触获得的认识，相对于理性系统知识的区分。

name: 经验传承的局限
label: education
description: The observation that most experience cannot be directly transmitted as rules because the tacit elements that make it effective are unavailable to the transmitter's own introspection.
description-chinese: 经验多无法以规则传递、因其有效所依赖的隐性成分不可言说。

name: 经验综合
label: education
description: The consolidation of many particular observations into a general account, the traditional counterpart to induction and the operation that yields both natural laws and durable or fleeting stereotypes.
description-chinese: 把个别观察整合为一般性叙述、既能产生规律也能产生刻板印象。

name: 结构化思维
label: education
description: 将复杂问题拆解为可操作子问题、以可视化表征组织其关系并系统验证的思维方式，其可教学性来自提供了显式的步骤与外部化工具。
description-chinese: 将复杂问题拆解为可操作子问题、以可视化表征组织关系并系统验证的思维方式，可通过显式步骤教授。

name: 结构性挑战
label: education
description: A difficulty arising from the configuration of an institution itself, such as timetable granularity or assessment weighting, which therefore cannot be removed by changing attitudes or adding resources.
description-chinese: 源于制度配置本身、无法靠改变态度或增加资源解决的困难。

name: 缄默知识
label: education
description: The large body of knowledge that practitioners can apply competently but cannot readily articulate or formalize, such as the cues an expert uses to judge a situation.
description-chinese: 实践者能熟练运用却难以言说与形式化的知识。

name: 群体学习
label: education
description: Learning that takes place among peers or a class as a unit, in which the interactions between members are themselves the vehicle for learning rather than mere logistics around individual work.
description-chinese: 以同伴或班级为单位、以成员间交互本身为学习途径的学习。

name: 群文阅读
label: education
description: 将多篇主题相关而非文体相同的文本并置比较的教学形态，要求学生在差异中发现共同议题并在多元视角间作出判断，其效度取决于文本选择是否形成真实张力。
description-chinese: 将多篇主题相关文本并置比较的教学形态，要求学生在差异中发现共同议题，效度取决于文本选择是否形成张力。

name: 育人伙伴
label: education
description: Systems positioned not as mere teaching tools but as partners sharing responsibility for developmental outcomes alongside teachers and families within a genuinely co-educating arrangement. Treating systems as partners raises normative questions about which responsibilities may legitimately be delegated to non-human actors in education.
description-chinese: 不定位为教学工具而定位为伙伴的系统，与教师、家庭在协同育人格局中共同承担发展责任。

name: 育人成效的可计算表征
name_cn: 育人成效的可计算表征
label: education
description: The attempt to render educational outcomes as measurable, aggregable and comparable indicators so that developmental effects can be evidenced rather than asserted. Computation necessarily narrows what counts, so the risk lies in allowing indicators to silently replace the educational aims they were meant to measure.
description-chinese: 将育人成效转化为可测量、可汇总、可比较之指标，使发展效应得以被举证而非仅被宣称。

name: 能力压缩
label: education
description: The tendency for routinized cognitive operations to be offloaded to external tools, so that the learner retains only a compressed summary rather than the full sequence of formerly executed steps.
description-chinese: 例行认知操作外包给工具后，学习者只保留压缩摘要而非完整步骤。

name: 能力增强
label: education
description: The condition in which a learner can perform tasks that would have been impossible before instruction, as distinct from merely performing familiar tasks faster or with less effort.
description-chinese: 学习者能完成此前无法完成的任务、而非仅把熟任务做得更快。

name: 自主学习
label: education
description: Learning carried out without externally assigned goals or deadlines, in which the learner sets objectives, selects materials, schedules work, and monitors their own progress against self-chosen criteria.
description-chinese: 学习者自行设定目标、选择材料并监控进度的学习方式。

name: 自我参照
label: education
description: Processing of information by relating it to the self, which deepens elaboration and encoding and thereby improves later recall of the material. Recall typically exceeds semantically matched conditions, though the effect diminishes when elaboration is shallow or the self-reference is not meaningfully processed.
description-chinese: 将信息与自我相联系进行加工的过程，可加深精细化与编码从而提升后续回忆。

name: 自我管理
label: education
description: The learner's regulation of time, materials, emotion and attention in pursuit of goals, a core component of self-regulated learning and of student agency. Self-management instruction is most effective where routines are explicitly modelled, since learners cannot imitate strategies they have never observed.
description-chinese: 学习者为达成目标而对时间、材料、情绪与注意加以调节，是自我调节学习与学生能动性的核心成分。

name: 自然互动
label: education
description: Free-play or semi-structured interaction with no prescribed task or script, allowing the learner to initiate topics, so that behaviours such as joint attention emerge spontaneously rather than being cued.
description-chinese: 无规定任务与脚本的互动，使联合注意等行为自发出现。

name: 自闭症儿童组
label: education
description: The experimental group in a comparative design, composed of children meeting diagnostic criteria for autism spectrum disorder, matched to control participants on age, sex, and language level.
description-chinese: 对照设计中的实验组，由符合孤独症诊断标准的儿童组成。

name: 范式转换
label: education
cite-bibtex-full:

  title     = {The Structure of Scientific Revolutions},

  year      = {1962},
  series    = {International Encyclopedia of Unified Science},

description: A change in the accepted exemplars, methods, and values of a discipline that reorients research practice and leaves earlier work addressable but no longer motivating.
description-chinese: 学科范例方法与价值取向的更替，使旧工作仍可理解却不再具有引导力。

name: 行为选择
label: education
description: The modeled process by which an agent picks among available actions given its current state, treated as the observable output variable through which latent intentions and constraints can be inferred.
description-chinese: 主体依据当前状态从可选动作中做出选择的过程。

name: 规模化循证
label: education
description: Extending efficacy findings from controlled trials into large-scale real deployments, requiring attention to whether effects persist when instructional context, teacher practice, and population composition change.
description-chinese: 把对照试验的疗效结论推广到大规模真实部署并检验效应能否保持。

name: 规模应用与数据反哺
label: education
description: A deployment pattern in which an educational AI system is rolled out across many schools and sites, and the resulting accumulated usage data is fed back to refine the underlying model and teaching design.
description-chinese: 系统跨多校落地部署并把积累的使用数据反哺模型与教学设计的模式。

name: 视频学习
label: education
description: Learning from recorded or streamed audiovisual material, in which the learner's ability to select segments and control pacing mediates comprehension and retention. Signalling, segmenting and learner-paced control are the design variables most often manipulated, and their relative contributions shift with prior knowledge.
description-chinese: 从录制或流式视听材料中学习，选择片段与控制节奏在其中中介理解与保持。

name: 言语加工
label: education
description: The decoding, phonological, syntactic, and semantic operations by which spoken or written language is converted into meaning, profiled across these levels to locate the source of a language difficulty.
description-chinese: 把语音与书面语言转换为意义的解码、音韵、句法与语义加工。

name: 计算教育学
label: education
description: A research field applying computational modelling, machine learning and data-intensive experimentation to build explanatory accounts of learning and teaching processes. Its methodological strength lies in generating testable predictions prospectively, rather than retrospectively interpreting observational data after the fact.
description-chinese: 运用计算建模、机器学习与数据密集实验对学习与教学过程建立解释性模型的学科。

name: 认知对象
label: education
description: The entity or aspect that a subject is attending to at a given moment, distinguished from the activity of thinking about it so that the same content can be approached from different directions.
description-chinese: 主体在某一时刻所指向的对象，与关于它的思维活动相区分。

name: 认知神经机制
label: education
description: The identification of brain networks and physiological processes causally implicated in a given cognitive function, used to constrain and refine psychological explanations. Reverse inference remains a persistent difficulty, since observed activation does not by itself establish which mental representation or process produced it.
description-chinese: 确认与特定认知功能存在因果关联的脑网络与生理过程，用于约束并精化心理学解释。

name: 认知裂缝
label: education
description: A persistent discontinuity between what a learner can articulate and what they can actually do, or between performance with and without assistance, signalling that the apparent understanding is shallow.
description-chinese: 能说清与能做到、或有无辅助下表现之间的持续性断裂。

name: 认知责任
label: education
description: The obligation of a learner to exercise and be accountable for their own thinking when AI assistance is available, rather than transferring that duty to the tool. Compliance is usually probed by removing assistance and testing whether the learner's reasoning degrades accordingly relative to their supported performance.
description-chinese: 在AI辅助可用时学习者仍须运用并为自身思考负责、而非把该责任转移给工具的义务。

name: 认知资源清单
label: education
description: An explicit enumeration of the specific mental operations a task demands from working memory, reasoning, and perception, used to diagnose why an ostensibly simple task fails for particular learners.
description-chinese: 明确列举某任务对工作记忆、推理与知觉的特定心理操作要求。

name: 议题驱动
label: education
description: Curricular organization in which content is selected because it supports the analysis of a contested public problem, so that knowledge is acquired in the service of taking a position.
description-chinese: 以分析争议性公共问题为选取内容依据的课程组织方式。

name: 证据链
label: education
description: An ordered sequence connecting an observation through intermediate inferences to a conclusion, where each link states its warrant so that any single weak link can be located and examined.
description-chinese: 由观察经中间推论连接到结论、每环均说明依据的有序推理链。

name: 评价技术
label: education
description: The instruments, rubrics and procedures by which achievement is observed and interpreted, treated as a subject of critical inquiry rather than a neutral instrument. Because instruments shape what gets noticed, their construction embeds theoretical commitments that should be made explicit and contested openly.
description-chinese: 用以观察与解读成就的工具、量规与程序，本身即成为批判性研究对象而非中立工具。

name: 评价方式单一
label: education
description: Reliance on a narrow repertoire of assessment instruments, typically written summative examinations, which narrows the taught curriculum and systematically misrepresents multidimensional learning. Consequences include teaching to the assessed format, which progressively decouples measured attainment from genuine understanding.
description-chinese: 评价工具类型狭窄、依赖笔试等终结性测验，导致课程窄化并误判多维学习表现。

name: 诊断延迟
label: education
description: The interval between the onset of observable difficulties and the point at which a formal diagnosis is made, often long in autism and directly shaping the age at which support begins.
description-chinese: 从症状出现到获得正式诊断的时间间隔，直接影响支持介入的年龄。

name: 语感
label: education
description: An intuitive and largely tacit sensitivity to the appropriateness, nuance and rhythm of linguistic expression, acquired through long exposure and practice rather than through explicit study of grammatical rules. Its development is generally attributed to extensive reading and imitation rather than to rule explanation, which shapes how it should be cultivated instructionally.
description-chinese: 经长期浸润与实践习得、对语言表达恰当性的直觉性敏感，而非依循明示语法规则。

name: 语言经验
label: education
description: The accumulated practical exposure to language use in real communicative contexts, treated as the developmental basis upon which linguistic knowledge and language ability are subsequently systematized and made explicit. Making this tacit resource explicit constitutes the core task of mother tongue instruction, since unarticulated experience cannot be consciously revised.
description-chinese: 在真实交际情境中累积的语言运用经验，被视为语言知识与能力得以系统化的重要发展基础。

name: 语言运用
label: education
description: 在具体语境中以口头与书面形式恰当地理解并表达意义的活动，被视为母语课程的核心目标，其教学指向语境中的选择而非规则的记忆。
description-chinese: 在具体语境中以口头与书面形式恰当地理解并表达意义的活动，被视为母语课程核心目标。

name: 读写迁移
label: education
description: 阅读中所获得的写法、语体与篇章结构知识在写作任务中被调用并改写的现象，其促成条件是读写活动在任务层面形成显式对应而非孤立布置。
description-chinese: 阅读获得的写法、语体与篇章结构知识在写作中被调用改写的现象，需读写任务在任务层面显式对应。

name: 课堂变革
label: education
description: Structural change in classroom organization, interaction and assessment practice induced by digital technology, as distinct from merely substituting devices for existing routines. Change at this level concerns interaction structure and assessment practice, which is substantially more demanding than introducing new devices.
description-chinese: 数字技术引发的课堂组织、互动与评价实践的结构性变革，区别于仅以设备替代既有流程。

name: 课堂工具
label: education
description: Reusable software affordances available during instruction for polling, quizzing, collaborative work and resource display, selected by teachers to serve pedagogical intent. Tool selection should follow from the instructional objective, since each available affordance imposes attentional demands competing with the task itself.
description-chinese: 教学中可供调用的可复用软件功能，如投票、测验、协作与资源展示，由教师依教学意图选用。

name: 课程互动
label: education
description: Structured opportunities within a course for learners to act upon content and receive consequential feedback, ranging from quizzes and peer discussion to collaborative problem-solving and argumentation. Interaction has pedagogical value only when it produces consequences for the learner's subsequent reasoning rather than merely evidenced engagement.
description-chinese: 课程中供学习者作用于内容并获得反馈的结构化机会，涵盖测验、同伴讨论到协作问题解决。

name: 课程标准
label: education
description: The official document specifying curriculum aims, content, learning requirements and assessment principles that bound what schools may teach and students are expected to learn. Standards constrain but do not determine practice, as the gap between prescribed and enacted curriculum is empirically substantial.
description-chinese: 规定课程目标、内容、学业要求与评价原则的官方文件，界定学校可教与学生应学的边界。

name: 课程知识体系
label: education
description: The organized network of concepts, methods, and relations that a discipline presents to learners, distinguished from the discipline's actual research practice and its everyday application.
description-chinese: 学科向学习者呈现的概念、方法与关系构成的组织网络。

name: 课程观
label: education
description: 关于课程本质、目标、内容组织与实施主体的观念总和，决定了教学设计是围绕学科逻辑还是围绕学生经验展开，是教师作出 curricular 决策的深层前提。
description-chinese: 关于课程本质、目标、内容组织与实施主体的观念总和，决定教学设计围绕学科逻辑还是学生经验。

name: 课程设置
label: education
description: The structural decisions by which content is selected, sequenced, and allocated time in a programme, determining what learners are positioned to study and in what order.
description-chinese: 对内容进行选择、排序与课时分配的结构性决策。

name: 责任归属
label: education
description: The normative question of who is accountable when an AI-assisted educational outcome proves defective, tracing responsibility across tool designers, teachers, institutions and the learner themselves. Accountability frameworks must specify not only who answers for outcomes but also who retains authority to refuse automated recommendations.
description-chinese: 在AI辅助的教育结果有缺陷时，责任如何在工具设计者、教师、机构与学习者之间分配的问题。

name: 资源不均衡
label: education
description: The unequal distribution of hardware, software, teacher quality and learning opportunities across schools or regions, producing persistent and cumulatively accumulating gaps in educational attainment. Because resource differences compound over a learner's schooling rather than averaging out, initial disparities widen rather than merely persist.
description-chinese: 硬件、软件、师资与学习机会在学校或区域间的分布不均，造成持续的教育成就差距。

name: 跨学科
label: education
description: The integration of methods, concepts or curricula across distinct disciplinary boundaries so that problems spanning fields can be addressed without fragmentation. A useful distinction separates multidisciplinary work, where disciplines merely contribute, from interdisciplinary and transdisciplinary collaboration that reorganises them.
description-chinese: 跨越学科边界整合方法、概念或课程以应对跨域问题的做法。

name: 跨学科教研共同体
label: education
description: A sustained community of practice in which teachers from different subjects jointly plan, observe and interpret instruction to align curriculum around shared outcomes. Sustained joint work is what makes genuine curricular alignment possible, since alignment cannot be established through brief consultation alone.
description-chinese: 由不同学科教师组成的持续性实践共同体，共同规划、观课与解读教学以围绕共同目标对齐课程。

name: 跨时空多主体协同教学
name_cn: 跨时空多主体协同教学
label: education
description: Instructional organization in which teachers, learners, and digital resources situated in different places and at different times coordinate their contributions toward a single shared instructional goal.
description-chinese: 不同地点与时间的教师、学习者及数字资源围绕共同目标协同的教学。

name: 身体活动
label: education
description: The biological substrate of mental activity involving energy metabolism, blood supply, and physical system functioning, treated as a determinant of cognitive performance rather than as incidental background.
description-chinese: 涉及代谢、供血与生理系统运作的心智活动物质基础。

name: 过程性数据
label: education
description: Fine-grained traces of learning activity collected during the learning process itself, such as clickstreams, intermediate edits and attempt histories, as opposed to end-point outcome scores alone. Such traces support timely intervention, yet their volume poses genuine interpretive problems unless analytic questions are fixed in advance.
description-chinese: 在学习过程中采集的细粒度活动痕迹，如点击流、编辑与作答记录，区别于终点结果分数。

name: 近邻繁殖
label: education
description: The mechanism by which ideas and practices spread because individuals preferentially learn from and reproduce those nearest to them, producing locally uniform but globally diverse outcomes.
description-chinese: 个体现向最邻近者学习与复制而使观念传播的机制。

name: 连接主义
label: education

  journal = {Nature},
  volume  = {323},
  number  = {6088},
  pages   = {533--536},
  year    = {1986},
  month   = {oct},

}
cite-abstract: We describe a new learning procedure, back-propagation, for networks of neurone-like units. The procedure repeatedly adjusts the weights of the connections in the network so as to minimize a measure of the difference between the actual output vector of the net and the desired output vector. As a result of the weight adjustments, internal 'hidden' units which are not part of the input or output come to represent important features of the task domain, and the regularities in the task are captured by the interactions of these units. The ability to create useful new features distinguishes back-propagation from earlier, simpler methods such as the perceptron-convergence procedure.
description: The modelling approach that explains cognition as patterns of activation spreading through weighted connections between simple units, learning occurring through adjustment of those connection strengths.
description-chinese: 以激活在简单单元的加权连接间扩散来解释认知与学习的建模取向。

name: 适应性教学策略
label: education
description: Instructional procedures selected and adjusted in response to measured learner state so that task difficulty, hint level and pacing track individual progress. Adaptation risks entrench initial misdiagnosis, since learner models inferred from sparse early evidence will adapt instruction to an inaccurate picture.
description-chinese: 依据测量到的学习状态选择与调整教学程序，使任务难度、提示水平与节奏匹配个体进展。

name: 重复刻板行为
label: education
description: Repetitive motor movements or vocalizations occurring in fixed patterns, one of the diagnostic criteria used to describe restricted and repetitive behaviour in autism spectrum disorder.
description-chinese: 以固定模式重复出现的动作或发声，属孤独症谱系障碍的限制性重复行为。

name: 问题创设
label: education
description: The pedagogical activity of generating questions worth investigating, which positions learners as producers of knowledge rather than as consumers of given problems. Quality criteria include relevance to the domain, solvability, and openness to genuinely divergent lines of investigation rather than a single expected answer.
description-chinese: 生成值得探究的问题的教学活动，使学习者成为知识的生产者而非给定问题的消费者。

name: 问题表征
label: education
description: The learner's internal encoding of a problem's surface features and deep structure, which determines which solution procedures become available to them. Representation quality predicts strategy selection more reliably than general intelligence measures do, and is correspondingly more sensitive to instruction.
description-chinese: 学习者对问题表层特征与深层结构的内部编码，决定其可用的解题程序。

name: 问题解决
label: education
description: The cognitive process of transforming a problem state into a goal state through a sequence of actions, requiring planning, execution and monitoring of progress. Expertise manifests as shorter and more schematic search paths rather than faster primitive operations, and is largely insensitive to additional time on task.
description-chinese: 通过一系列行动把问题状态转变为目标状态的认知过程，需规划、执行与进展监控。

name: 随机点名
label: education
description: 以随机方式而非自愿举手选择回答者的课堂提问策略，用于打破参与不均衡并提高全体思考率，其有效性依赖给予被点名学生充足的准备与退出时间。
description-chinese: 以随机方式而非自愿举手选择回答者的提问策略，用于打破参与不均衡，需给予充足准备与退出时间。

name: 隐性学习策略
label: education
description: 以模仿、体验与直觉迁移获取难以言明知识的非正式学习方式，强调在实践中通过沉浸与反馈形成能力，而非依赖显性规则陈述与规则复述。
description-chinese: 通过模仿、体验与直觉迁移获得难以言明知识的非正式学习方式，重实践沉浸与反馈而非显性规则复述。

name: 隐性知识
label: education
description: Knowledge held in practice that cannot be fully articulated in propositional form, including craft skills, expert intuitions and contextual know-how transmitted chiefly by demonstration, imitation and apprenticeship. Codification efforts invariably capture only the explicable residue, which is why demonstration and guided practice remain irreplaceable in vocational formation.
description-chinese: 实践中持有而无法完全以命题形式言说的知识，含技艺、直觉与情境性经验，靠示范与师徒制传递。

name: 雷达图
label: education
description: A multivariate chart mapping profiles onto multiple axes, used in education to display several evaluation dimensions simultaneously and expose uneven profiles. The visualization makes unevenness visible, though polygon area can mislead readers and should not be read as a quantitative summary.
description-chinese: 将测评结果映射到多条轴上的多变量图表，教育中用于同时呈现多个评价维度并暴露不均衡结构。

name: 项目研究
label: education
description: Inquiry organized around a sustained question pursued over extended time, requiring literature synthesis, evidence collection and iterative revision of understanding. Sustained inquiry requires explicit staging and formative feedback, since projects otherwise drift indefinitely without converging on conclusions.
description-chinese: 围绕长期追问组织的探究，要求文献综合、证据收集与对理解的反复修正。

name: 验证工具
label: education
description: A procedure or instrument for deciding whether a claim survives contact with evidence, ranging from empirical test to logical check, whose adequacy depends on the type of claim being assessed.
description-chinese: 用于判定主张能否经受证据检验的程序或工具。

name: 高孤独症特质
label: education
description: A dimensional score placing an individual along a continuum of autistic traits, used to study social-cognitive correlates without imposing a categorical diagnosis on the sample.
description-chinese: 在孤独症特质连续谱上定位个体的维度分数。

name: 高阶学习状态表征
label: education
description: A representation of the learner that encodes relational and strategic features such as concept connections and problem-solving approach, rather than only correct-answer histories or response latency.
description-chinese: 编码概念关联与解题策略等关系性特征而非仅答题记录的学习者表征。

name: 高阶思维评价
label: education
description: Assessment design and scoring procedures aimed at crediting analysis, evaluation and creation in student work rather than only the reproduction of correct answers. Scoring reliability falls sharply when rubrics mix process and quality criteria within a single dimension, since raters then weight them differently.
description-chinese: 针对学生作品中的分析、评价与创造给予计分的评价设计与实施方法，而非只看正确答案。

name: 高阶能力
label: education
description: The cluster of transferable competencies comprising analysis, evaluation, creation and problem solving, as distinct from recall of domain-specific factual content. Transferable components are identified through factor analysis across varied tasks and content domains, since factor structure depends heavily on the task set sampled.
description-chinese: 由分析、评价、创造与解决问题等构成的可迁移胜任群，区别于领域事实的回忆。
